products.page_description: Powered by Shokz SuperBoost, OpenFit Pro combines advanced hardware with Open-Ear Noise Reduction for sound that’s clear, rich, and immersive. Dolby Atmos optimization with head-tracking brings every note to life, while AI-powered triple mics ensure crystal-clear calls. Ergonomic titanium ear hooks and Ultra-Soft Silicone 2.0 deliver a secure, all-day comfortable fit. Enjoy extended playtime, Qi wireless charging, and balanced performance—crafted to keep you connected through every moment.

feature_entries.title: Superior Sound with Rich Detail
feature_entries.description: Powered by Shokz SuperBoost™ and Shokz OpenBass™ 2.0, OpenFit Pro delivers sound that’s dynamic and distortion-free. The ultra-large 11 × 20 mm* dual-diaphragm driver adds rich detail, smooth highs, and deep lows for a balanced, precise listening experience. Optimized for Dolby Atmos, it surrounds you with lifelike immersion, while head-tracking technology keeps you at the center of every scene.

feature_entries.title: Innovative Shokz Open-Ear Noise Reduction
feature_entries.description: OpenFit Pro is the first Shokz earbud to feature Open-Ear Noise Reduction. It combines Shokz’ signature open-ear design with innovative noise control, delivering immersive listening that minimizes distractions while preserving natural awareness. A triple-mic system and ear-adaptive algorithm precisely predict in-ear noise levels, while intelligent noise reduction adjusts in real time. You can also fine-tune the level manually to suit your surroundings.

feature_entries.title: Designed for Lasting Comfort and Stability
feature_entries.description: Engineered with ultra-thin nickel-titanium alloy ear hooks, OpenFit Pro stays secure through every movement of your day. Shokz Ultra-Soft Silicone™ 2.0 provides a gentle, skin-friendly touch for hours of wear, while the open-ear design eliminates pressure on your ears, keeping you comfortable through long workouts and long days.

feature_entries.title: Crafted for Performance. Powered by Innovation
feature_entries.description: Crafted from premium aluminum alloy, OpenFit Pro achieves a seamless unibody design that’s strong, lightweight, and refined in every detail. The raised-profile microphone with a Noise Reduction Ring ensures precise sound capture in the ear canal for more accurate noise reduction. During calls, our directional sound channel enhances voice pickup and airflow control, reducing wind interference for clear, natural calls.

feature_entries.title: Up to 50 Hours and Wireless Charging
feature_entries.description: Stay charged for the long run with up to 50 hours of playback, or 24 hours with Open-Ear Noise Reduction enabled when using the charging case. Get 6 hours on a single charge with Open-Ear Noise Reduction on, or 12 hours when it’s off. Need a quick boost? A 10-minute quick charge gives you up to 4 hours of playtime, perfect for last-minute workouts or calls. And with wireless charging, recharging is effortless. Just set the case down and you’re good to go.

feature_entries.title: AI-optimized Call Clarity
feature_entries.description: Stay heard in every environment with a triple-mic array powered by AI voice recognition, reducing background noise by up to 99.4% and locking onto your voice for sharper clarity. Paired with custom wind-control technology, calls remain clear even in gusts up to 25 km/h, whether you’re commuting, training, or on the move.

feature_entries.title: Control made simple and reliable
feature_entries.description: Waterproof physical buttons with a raised profile give you confident, precise control. The tactile design minimizes accidental presses, ensuring reliable operation in any condition.

feature_entries.title: Easy MultiPoint Pairing
feature_entries.description: Connect OpenFit Pro to 2 devices at once through the Shokz App and switch seamlessly between them—your phone, tablet, or laptop. Move from work calls to playlists without delay, staying connected for every moment.

feature_entries.title: Ready for Sweat, Rain, and Dust
feature_entries.description: With an IP55 rating, OpenFit Pro is built to handle daily demands, whether it’s a tough workout, a sudden drizzle, or the pace of your workday. Durable by design, it keeps performing when things get intense.

feature_entries.title: Smart Wear Detection
feature_entries.description: OpenFit Pro features a hybrid optical and capacitive sensor system. This ensures precise detection by adapting to different ear shapes, automatically playing music when worn, and pausing instantly when removed.

feature_entries.title: Bluetooth® 6.1 Stability
feature_entries.description: With Bluetooth® 6.1, OpenFit Pro ensures a stable connection up to 10 m (33 ft)*, giving you reliable performance as you move. The case opens to instant pairing, so your audio is ready when you are.

feature_entries.title: Smarter Listening with the Shokz App
feature_entries.description: Adjust noise reduction to your surroundings, enable “Optimized for Dolby Atmos” for immersive sound, and fine-tune audio with 5 preset EQ modes or 2 customizable EQs. Customize button controls for volume, playback, skipping tracks, and voice assistant access. You can also locate your earbuds with one-click ringing, keep firmware up to date, and enjoy a fully tailored open-ear experience that keeps you connected and in control.

products.page_description: Introducing OpenDots ONE, the new open-ear clip-on earbuds from Shokz. With a fresh take on audio, OpenDots ONE is designed to keep you connected without the isolation. Simply clip them on and immerse yourself in your favorite sounds, wherever life takes you.

feature_entries.title: Stay Locked-in and Secure
feature_entries.description: With a durable nickel-titanium plate and a soft silicone grip, OpenDots ONE stays put through your most intense workouts. No adjustments, no distractions, just you and your music.

feature_entries.title: Lightweight + Headwear Compatible
feature_entries.description: At just 6.5g per earbud, the OpenDots ONE is incredibly lightweight and portable. It also won't clash with your favorite eyewear, hats, or other accessories.

feature_entries.title: Mighty Sound, Mini Size
feature_entries.description: Don't let their size fool you. OpenDots ONE packs a powerful punch. Our dual-driver design, enhanced by Bassphere Technology, delivers deep, rich bass and crystal-clear highs.

feature_entries.title: Dolby Audio + Customizable Sound
feature_entries.description: Tailor your listening experience with 4 pre-set EQ modes - Standard, Vocal, Bass and Private Mode - or create your own custom profile via the Shokz App. And with Dolby Audio, you'll hear every note and beat, brought to life.

feature_entries.title: DirectPitch Technology for Listening Privacy
feature_entries.description: DirectPitch Technology ensures your music stays between you and your earbuds. By minimizing sound leakage, you can enjoy your favorite tunes without disturbing those around you.

feature_entries.title: Up to 40 Hours of Listening Time + Wireless Charging
feature_entries.description: Enjoy up to 10 hours of uninterrupted listening on a single charge. Plus, with the charging case, you can extend your listening time to a full 40 hours. Experience the convenience of wireless charging. Simply set your charging case on a charging pad and let it recharge effortlessly.

feature_entries.title: Quick Charge
feature_entries.description: Need a quick audio boost? A 10-minute charge is all it takes to power your earbuds for 2 hours of listening.

feature_entries.title: Interchangeable Left/Right Earbud
feature_entries.description: With our advanced Dynamic Ear Detection Technology, OpenDots ONE automatically recognizes which earbud is in which ear, allowing for interchangeable wear.

feature_entries.title: Easy Touch Control
feature_entries.description: Control music and calls with a tap on the battery compartment or JointArc, or ‘pinch’ the battery compartment with two fingers.

feature_entries.title: IP54 Water Resistant
feature_entries.description: With an IP54 water resistance rating, the OpenDots ONE can handle light rain and sweat so you can keep the music going, rain or shine.

feature_entries.title: MultiPoint Pairing
feature_entries.description: Connect to two devices simultaneously thanks to MultiPoint Pairing, and switch between them effortlessly with the Shokz App.

feature_entries.title: More Shokz App features
feature_entries.description: Activate Dolby Audio for immersive sound, find your earbuds when you’ve misplaced them, and more.

feature_entries.title: Wireless Connectivity
feature_entries.description: Powered by Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC and AAC support, OpenDots ONE delivers stable connections and premium audio across your devices. With a wireless range up to 33 ft (10 m), it pairs easily with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and smartwatches for smooth streaming, calls, and more.

feature_entries.title: Voice Assistant
feature_entries.description: Activate your smartphone’s voice assistant with customizable touch controls through the Shokz app. Play music, answer calls, or get directions—hands-free, without reaching for your phone.

products.page_description: OpenRun Pro 2 - Open Your Ears to a World of Groundbreaking Audio. The OpenRun Pro 2 rewrites the rules of open-ear listening with DualPitch technology, blending bone conduction for clear mids and highs with air conduction for deep bass. Experience the depth and clarity of 3D audio with a custom algorithm placing every sound with precision, all while staying aware of your surroundings for enhanced safety. The secure, ergonomic fit with a weight-optimized frame guarantees stability without sacrificing comfort, even during intense workouts.

feature_entries.title: Dual Driver for Groundbreaking Audio Improvement
feature_entries.description: OpenRun Pro 2 redefines open-ear audio with DualPitch technology, blending bone conduction for clear mids and highs with air conduction for deep bass.

feature_entries.title: 3D Audio Perfection for Immersive Sound Experiences
feature_entries.description: Experience incredible 3D audio with a custom algorithm that assigns each sound element to a dedicated driver, creating a balanced, dynamic soundscape. DRC technology ensures distortion-free listening, even at peak volume.

feature_entries.title: Open-Ear Comfort
feature_entries.description: Featuring Shokz's open-ear design, the OpenRun Pro 2 keeps you aware of your surroundings while you work out, helping to improve safety and enhancing your listening experience. It optimizes volume range for clear audio even when you're on the go.

feature_entries.title: Leak-Free Audio
feature_entries.description: The bone conduction unit features an integrated design, encasing all components within a protective metal compartment helping to minimize sound leakage. Plus, DirectPitch technology further reduces air conduction unit leakage, delivering crystal-clear audio for you, and enhanced privacy.

feature_entries.title: Secure Fit
feature_entries.description: Engineered for the extremes, OpenRun Pro 2's ergonomic ear hooks and unibody frame provide a secure, comfortable fit that defies slips and adjustments. Experience unshakeable stability thanks to the weight-optimized design, while integrated Ni-Ti alloy memory wire delivers a clamping force that's secure without being uncomfortable – even during intense activities.

feature_entries.title: Cloud-Comfort Fit
feature_entries.description: Shokz's open-ear design and DualPitch technology reduce vibrations, making the headphones comfortable for extended wear. With a 4° core contact area and 16% reduction in clamping force, the headphones offer a feather-light fit and even pressure distribution.

feature_entries.title: IP55 Water-Resistant
feature_entries.description: Rain, sweat, splashes – bring it on. An IP55 water-resistant design, including a double-layer mesh structure and nano-hydrophobic coating, ensures durability against the elements.

feature_entries.title: AI Noise Reduction Algorithm for Crystal-Clear Call Quality

products.page_description: Powered by our next-gen processor and intelligent algorithms, the WH-1000XM6 premium headphones deliver studio-quality sound and our most advanced noise cancellation. Co-created with mastering audio engineers, every detail and note are heard as the artist intended. Enjoy a pure, uninterrupted listening experience anywhere with crystal-clear call quality and pro-level audio.

feature_entries.title: The Best Noise Cancellation*
feature_entries.description: Powered by advanced processors and an adaptive microphone system, the WH-1000XM6 headphones deliver real-time noise cancellation for an immersive, distraction-free listening experience.

feature_entries.title: Co-created with Mastering Audio Engineers
feature_entries.description: Developed in collaboration with world-renowned mastering audio engineers, these headphones deliver unparalleled sound clarity and precision. A specially designed driver with a lightweight carbon fiber dome delivers high fidelity sound, where rich vocals and every instrument remains pure and balanced. Optimized for advanced noise cancellation, the WH-1000XM6 headphones keep every frequency crisp and true to the artist’s intent.

feature_entries.title: HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN3
feature_entries.description: The HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN3 is 7x faster than the QN1 (found in our WH-1000XM5 headphones), optimizing 12 microphones in real time for superior noise cancellation, sound quality, and call clarity. With more microphones than ever, we can precisely detect external noise and counteracts it with opposite soundwaves, delivering a new level of noise cancellation.

feature_entries.title: Adaptive NC Optimizer
feature_entries.description: Our new Adaptive NC Optimizer intelligently adjusts to a variety of factors, including external noise, air pressure, and your wearing style, even while wearing a hat or glasses, for uninterrupted, immersive sound. This technology monitors your environment to ensure you enjoy the purest, most immersive sound, no matter where you are.

feature_entries.title: Auto Ambient Sound Mode
feature_entries.description: Our Auto Ambient Sound mode adapts to your surroundings in real time by balancing music and external sound. The multiple microphones can filter out the noise or let in what matters: announcements, conversations, or the world around you.

feature_entries.title: Authenticity, in every note
feature_entries.description: The newly developed look-ahead noise shaper D/A conversion technology in our HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN3, better anticipates and adjusts the combined output—reducing distortion, enhancing bass energy, and delivering crisp, fast sound that stays true to your music.

feature_entries.title: High-Resolution Audio
feature_entries.description: The WH-1000XM6 headphones support High-Resolution Audio and High-Resolution Audio Wireless, thanks to LDAC, our industry-adopted audio coding technology. LDAC transmits approximately three times more data than conventional Bluetooth audio for exceptional High-Resolution Audio quality.

feature_entries.title: Real-time File Restoration
feature_entries.description: Using Edge-AI, DSEE Extreme upscales compressed digital music files in real time. It dynamically identifies instrumentation, musical genres, and individual elements of each song, restoring high-range sound lost during compression.

feature_entries.title: Ultra-clear calls, from anywhere
feature_entries.description: A six-microphone AI-based beamforming system, intelligent noise reduction technology, and wind-resistant design, work together to isolate your voice, filter out background noise, and ensure every word comes through crisp and clear—even in the busiest environments.

feature_entries.title: Tailored Comfort, Thoughtfully Designed
feature_entries.description: A wider, asymmetrical headband with smooth synthetic leather ensures a pressure-free, all-day fit, while a stepless slider and seamless swivel make every adjustment effortless. Crafted for durability and style, the foldable design features precision metalwork and a compact case with a magnetic closure—ready to go wherever you do, in three premium colors: Black, Platinum Silver, and Midnight Blue.

feature_entries.title: Intuitive Controls
feature_entries.description: Tap, swipe, or press to switch between noise Cancelling, ambient sound, and mute, seamlessly. Adjust your music and volume with a simple touch, and your headphones even pause when you start talking, so you stay connected without missing a beat.

feature_entries.title: Sound Connect app
feature_entries.description: Customize your listening experience with the Sony | Sound Connect app. Fine-tune noise cancellation, adjust ambient sound levels, and personalize your EQ settings for your ideal listening preferences.

feature_entries.title: Long Battery Life and Convenient Charging
feature_entries.description: With up to 30 hours of battery life, these headphones ensure you’re powered for even the longest trips. When you’re running low, simply plug in the USB charging cable and keep listening, with both Bluetooth and audio cable connections supported. Charge for 3 minutes and you'll get up to 3 hours of playback with an optional USB-PD compatible AC adapter.

products.page_description: AirPods Pro 3. Up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation than AirPods Pro 2. Now with heart rate sensing, Live Translation, longer battery life, and advancements in hearing health. Redesigned for a more secure fit.

feature_entries.description: WORLD’S BEST IN-EAR ACTIVE NOISE CANCELLATION—Reduces up to 2x more unwanted noise than AirPods Pro 2 so you can stay fully immersed in the moment.¹

MAGICAL EXPERIENCE—Automatic Switching lets you seamlessly switch between your Apple devices.¹⁴ And Audio Sharing lets you share a song or show between two sets of AirPods on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV.¹⁵

products.page_description: AirPods 4-a totally transformed audio experience with Voice Isolation, Siri Interactions, and Personalized Spatial Audio. Featuring an updated fit for all-day comfort.

feature_entries.description: REBUILT FOR COMFORT—AirPods 4 have been redesigned for exceptional all-day comfort and greater stability. With a refined contour, shorter stem, and quick-press controls for music or calls.

PERSONALIZED SPATIAL AUDIO—Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking places sound all around you, creating a theater-like listening experience for music, TV shows, movies, games, and more.²

IMPROVED SOUND AND CALL QUALITY—AirPods 4 feature the Apple-designed H2 chip. Voice Isolation improves the quality of phone calls in loud conditions.¹ Using advanced computational audio, it reduces background noise while isolating and clarifying the sound of your voice for whoever you’re speaking to.

MAGICAL EXPERIENCE—Just say “Siri” or “Hey Siri” to play a song, make a call, or check your schedule.³ And with Siri Interactions,¹ now you can respond to Siri by simply nodding your head yes or shaking your head no.¹ Pair AirPods 4 by simply placing them near your device and tapping Connect on your screen. Easily share a song or show between two sets of AirPods.⁴
A skin-detecting sensor knows to play audio only when you’re wearing AirPods and pauses when you take them off. And you can track down your AirPods and Charging Case with the Find My app.⁵
LONG BATTERY LIFE—Get up to 5 hours of listening time on a single charge.⁶ And get up to 30 hours of total listening time using the case.⁷
REDESIGNED CASE—The Charging Case comes with USB-C charging capabilities and is more than 10 percent smaller by volume than the previous generation.⁸
DUST, SWEAT, AND WATER RESISTANT—AirPods 4 and the Charging Case are rated IP54 dust, sweat, and water resistant, so they’ll withstand rain and heavy workouts.⁹

products.page_description: Introducing OpenDots ONE, the new open-ear clip-on earbuds from Shokz. With a fresh take on audio, OpenDots ONE is designed to keep you connected without the isolation. Simply clip them on and immerse yourself in your favorite sounds, wherever life takes you.

feature_entries.title: Stay Locked-in and Secure
feature_entries.description: With a durable nickel-titanium plate and a soft silicone grip, OpenDots ONE stays put through your most intense workouts. No adjustments, no distractions, just you and your music.

feature_entries.title: Lightweight + Headwear Compatible
feature_entries.description: At just 6.5g per earbud, the OpenDots ONE is incredibly lightweight and portable. It also won't clash with your favorite eyewear, hats, or other accessories.

feature_entries.title: Mighty Sound, Mini Size
feature_entries.description: Don't let their size fool you. OpenDots ONE packs a powerful punch. Our dual-driver design, enhanced by Bassphere Technology, delivers deep, rich bass and crystal-clear highs.

feature_entries.title: Dolby Audio + Customizable Sound
feature_entries.description: Tailor your listening experience with 4 pre-set EQ modes - Standard, Vocal, Bass and Private Mode - or create your own custom profile via the Shokz App. And with Dolby Audio, you'll hear every note and beat, brought to life.

feature_entries.title: DirectPitch Technology for Listening Privacy
feature_entries.description: DirectPitch Technology ensures your music stays between you and your earbuds. By minimizing sound leakage, you can enjoy your favorite tunes without disturbing those around you.

feature_entries.title: Up to 40 Hours of Listening Time + Wireless Charging
feature_entries.description: Enjoy up to 10 hours of uninterrupted listening on a single charge. Plus, with the charging case, you can extend your listening time to a full 40 hours. Experience the convenience of wireless charging. Simply set your charging case on a charging pad and let it recharge effortlessly.

feature_entries.title: Quick Charge
feature_entries.description: Need a quick audio boost? A 10-minute charge is all it takes to power your earbuds for 2 hours of listening.

feature_entries.title: Interchangeable Left/Right Earbud
feature_entries.description: With our advanced Dynamic Ear Detection Technology, OpenDots ONE automatically recognizes which earbud is in which ear, allowing for interchangeable wear.

feature_entries.title: Easy Touch Control
feature_entries.description: Control music and calls with a tap on the battery compartment or JointArc, or ‘pinch’ the battery compartment with two fingers.

feature_entries.title: IP54 Water Resistant
feature_entries.description: With an IP54 water resistance rating, the OpenDots ONE can handle light rain and sweat so you can keep the music going, rain or shine.

feature_entries.title: MultiPoint Pairing
feature_entries.description: Connect to two devices simultaneously thanks to MultiPoint Pairing, and switch between them effortlessly with the Shokz App.

feature_entries.title: More Shokz App features
feature_entries.description: Activate Dolby Audio for immersive sound, find your earbuds when you’ve misplaced them, and more.

feature_entries.title: Wireless Connectivity
feature_entries.description: Powered by Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC and AAC support, OpenDots ONE delivers stable connections and premium audio across your devices. With a wireless range up to 33 ft (10 m), it pairs easily with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and smartwatches for smooth streaming, calls, and more.

feature_entries.title: Voice Assistant
feature_entries.description: Activate your smartphone’s voice assistant with customizable touch controls through the Shokz app. Play music, answer calls, or get directions—hands-free, without reaching for your phone.

products.page_description: AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation-featuring a totally transformed audio experience with Adaptive Audio and Transparency mode, and an updated fit for all-day comfort.

feature_entries.description: REBUILT FOR COMFORT—AirPods 4 have been redesigned for exceptional all-day comfort and greater stability. With a refined contour, shorter stem, and quick-press controls for music or calls.
ACTIVE NOISE CANCELLATION—AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation help reduce outside noise before it reaches your ears, so you can immerse yourself in what you’re listening to.²

HEAR THE WORLD AROUND YOU—The powerful H2 chip comes to AirPods 4. Adaptive Audio seamlessly blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode—which lets you comfortably hear and interact with the world around you exactly as it sounds—to provide the best listening experience in any environment.¹ And when you’re speaking with someone nearby, Conversation Awareness automatically lowers the volume of what’s playing.³

IMPROVED SOUND AND CALL QUALITY—Voice Isolation improves the quality of calls in loud conditions.³ Using advanced computational audio, it reduces background noise while isolating and clarifying the sound of your voice for whoever you’re speaking to.

MAGICAL EXPERIENCE—Just say “Siri” or “Hey Siri” to play a song, make a call, or check your schedule.⁴ And with Siri Interactions,³ now you can respond to Siri by simply nodding your head yes or shaking your head no.³ Pair AirPods 4 by simply placing them near your device and tapping Connect on your screen. Easily share a song or show between two sets of AirPods.⁵
A skin-detecting sensor knows to play audio only when you’re wearing AirPods and pauses when you take them off. And you can track down your AirPods and Charging Case with the Find My app.⁶

PERSONALIZED SPATIAL AUDIO—Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking places sound all around you, creating a theater-like listening experience for music, TV shows, movies, games, and more.⁷
REDESIGNED CASE—The Charging Case is the smallest in the industry with wireless charging. Charge with an Apple Watch charger, USB-C Charge Cable, or Qi-certified charger.⁸

LONG BATTERY LIFE—With Active Noise Cancellation enabled, get up to 4 hours of listening time on a single charge⁹ and up to 20 hours using the case. And you can get up to 30 hours of total listening time without Active Noise Cancellation enabled.¹⁰
DUST, SWEAT, AND WATER RESISTANT—AirPods 4 and the Charging Case are rated IP54 dust, sweat, and water resistant, so they’ll withstand rain and heavy workouts.¹¹

products.page_description: Audio lovers, the rich listening experience you’ve been waiting for is here with Galaxy Buds4 Pro. We’ve pulled out all the stops to craft Buds for those who want to hear the best in every note. Pop them in and press play. Hear vocals so pure, you get goosebumps. Feel bass that’s so deep, it moves you. Suddenly, you’re not just listening, you’re at the concert. Get closer to the sounds you love with dual speakers in each earbud for a more powerful soundstage. Cue up a track you’ve heard a hundred times. You’ll hear new details like it’s the first time thanks to a hi-res codec that preserves more musical detail than ever before. When you’re finished listening, place them in their redesigned charging case that keeps your Buds firmly in place while they charge. Hear the next-level audio experience your heart and ears have been craving with Buds4 Pro.

feature_entries.title: Sound with exceptional detail and clarity
feature_entries.description: Hear the richness of the sounds you love most with Hi-Res Audio¹ on Galaxy Buds4 Pro. Designed with a 24-bit hi-fi codec, they maintain the integrity of your favorite audio, over Bluetooth. From small reverbs to subtle textures, every detail sounds dynamic and clear.

feature_entries.title: Powerful sound for real music lovers
feature_entries.description: Enjoy a dynamic audio experience with dual speakers in each earbud. Galaxy Buds4 Pro feature a dedicated tweeter for rich highs and a separate woofer for deep, full bass. The result: Music comes to life with amazing depth, clarity and richness.

feature_entries.title: Calls so clear, it’s stunning
feature_entries.description: Enjoy clear phone calls with Galaxy Buds4 Pro and Galaxy S26 Series —they work together to deliver crisp and clear conversations. From juggling work calls to catching up with loved ones, confidently hear the difference loud and clear with the perfect pair.¹

feature_entries.title: Cancels noise. Adapts to your surroundings.
feature_entries.description: Enjoy sound to the fullest anywhere you go with Adaptive Active Noise Cancellation.⁵ Galaxy Buds4 Pro adjust sound levels based on your environment. Whether you’re at a bustling café or strolling through a park, your Buds will keep the audio you love front and center.

feature_entries.title: Day and night. Fits just right.
feature_entries.description: Feel the difference with Galaxy Buds4 Pro. Combining an improved, ear-hugging design with changeable ear tips, your Buds deliver that just-right fit so you can enjoy the audio you love in comfort.

feature_entries.title: Ask and AI will answer
feature_entries.description: Asking for help is easy with Galaxy Buds4 Pro and Galaxy S26 Series.² Simply speak a command out loud and they work together³ to knock out your task. From taking notes to setting reminders to finding a recipe, your Buds4 Pro are at the ready whenever you need them.

feature_entries.title: Made for every moment, rain or shine
feature_entries.description: No matter where you take them, peace of mind comes standard with Galaxy Buds4 Pro. Thanks to a water-and dust-resistant design⁴ and an IP57 rating, you can wear your Buds with confidence knowing they’re built for life on the go.

feature_entries.title: From phone to ear, translations you can hear
feature_entries.description: Trying to make a dinner reservation in another country over the phone? Galaxy Buds4 Pro and Live Translate¹ help you understand up to 22 other languages, just like that. Using the Samsung Phone app on your Galaxy S26 Series device, your Buds³ deliver a real-time translation of what the other person is saying right into your ear, leaving you hands-free to get ready for that special meal.

feature_entries.title: Touch controls with a personal touch
feature_entries.description: Control is just a gesture away with Intuitive Touch Control on Galaxy Buds4 Pro. Simply swipe your Buds to change the volume. A pinch gives you the power to play, pause or skip tracks. For quick access to custom shortcuts like app launches and more, just pinch and hold.

feature_entries.title: A sleek, new look
feature_entries.description: Stand out with the stylish blade design of Galaxy Buds4 Pro. Its sleek and refined shape comes with luxe metallic accents that look as great as your Buds sound.

Bose designed earbuds with OpenAudio technology that combines complete openness to your surroundings with rich, private sound only you can hear. Get your run on, take a call, go all day. feature_entries.title: Be in the music —anywhere, everywhere.
feature_entries.description: Get your run on, take a call, go all day. Do whatever your thing is and pause for nothing. Bose Immersive Audio spatializes music so you’re not only listening to the music. You’re in it.

feature_entries.title: A sight for sore ears.
feature_entries.description: Designed for comfortable all-day wear, you'll put these on and never want to take them off. The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds feature a flexible joint and stable, light-as-air-grip – you’ll forget you’re even wearing them.

feature_entries.title: Stay charged and never miss a beat.
feature_entries.description: With up to 7 hours of play time (up to 4 hours with Immersive Audio)¹ or up to 48 hours of standby,² you’re equipped with the power of long-lasting battery life. feature_entries.title: Press, play, enjoy.
feature_entries.description: Simple, satisfying button controls make it super easy to switch between stereo and immersive modes, giving you instant command over your listening experience. Just turn it on in the Bose app and move from place to place without needing to adjust a thing.

feature_entries.title: Water resistance with IPX4.
feature_entries.description: Get splashed on, dripped on, sprayed on. No worries here. The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds can handle it. Acoustic mesh keeps out moisture and debris, so you can keep on listening.

feature_entries.title: Plays nicely with other Bose products.
feature_entries.description: Indulge in TV time without bothering anyone. Thanks to Bose SimpleSync technology, you can pair your open-ear wireless headphones with Bose smart soundbars and speakers for a personal TV listening experience with independent volume control.

feature_entries.title: Seamless connection with advanced Bluetooth 5.3.
feature_entries.description: Now with improved Bluetooth connectivity and easier, quicker setup. Advanced Bluetooth 5.3 offers a strong, continuous connection within 30 feet of your device.

feature_entries.title: Control everything through the Bose app.
feature_entries.description: Take personalization even further with Adjustable EQ settings in the Bose app. Control bass, mid-range, and treble levels as you go. Or use the app to check battery life, customize a shortcut, and manage connected devices.

feature_entries.description: Powerbeats Pro 2 has secure-fit earhooks that stay locked in as you train. With over 1,500 hours of athlete testing to help ensure a secure, comfortable fit for any ear shape and intensity level.

For absolute workout focus, we added high-performing Active Noise Cancelling (ANC), plus Transparency mode to let you hear the world around you, ensuring a great listening experience wherever you train. ¹

Heart Rate Monitoring sensors pulse over 100 times per second to measure your pulse in real time. ² And Powerbeats Pro 2 is sweat and water resistant with an IPX4 rating, so they’re tough enough to handle training in rain, snow and heat. ³

Powered by the Apple H2 chip for extraordinary efficiency, Powerbeats Pro 2 delivers up to 45 hours of battery life with the charging case. ⁴ The case is 33% smaller than its predecessor and is our first ever to feature wireless Qi charging. ⁵

Compatible with Apple (one-touch pairing, automatic switching, Audio Sharing, hands-free Siri, Find My) and Android (the Beats App unlocks one-touch pairing, Heart Rate Monitoring, customizable controls, battery status widgets, and Locate My Beats). ⁶

Adaptive EQ uses advanced microphones to measure what you’re hearing, then adjusts the frequencies of your music to you. Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking delivers immersive sound, with clear highs, rich mid-range tones and powerful bass. ⁷
Take calls, FaceTime with Spatial Audio and activate Siri with Class 1 Bluetooth connectivity. Each earbud has advanced microphones that have been updated to ensure exceptional call quality.
The earbuds' on-ear buttons, tactile volume rockers and voice-activated controls make it easier to focus on training without disrupting your flow.

The earhook has been reinforced with a nickel titanium alloy for phenomenal flexibility, grip and comfort, making the next-generation Powerbeats Pro 2 20% lighter than its predecessor. Five ear tip sizes are included for personalized comfort.

feature_entries.title: JBL Pure Bass sound
feature_entries.description: JBL Vibe Beam 2 earbuds feature 8mm dynamic drivers that deliver exciting JBL Pure Bass sound.

feature_entries.title: Active Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient
feature_entries.description: JBL Vibe Beam 2 earbuds come with Active Noise Cancelling to listen to your surroundings and filter out distracting noise. Smart Ambient lets you control how much of the outside world you want to hear, so you can talk with others or stay aware of your surroundings—all without taking your earbuds out.

feature_entries.title: 4 mics for crisp, clear calls
feature_entries.description: Two mics on each earbud pick up and clearly transmit your voice while canceling out ambient noise. So you can make clear, crisp calls even when you're walking through a busy park on a breezy day.

feature_entries.title: Water and dust resistant
feature_entries.description: Your JBL Vibe Beam 2 are IP54 water and dust resistant, so you can use them in rainy or windy conditions. Even the case is IPX2 resistant, so don't worry about bringing it along with you.

feature_entries.title: JBL Headphones app
feature_entries.description: Use the JBL Headphones app to select the EQ that fits your style—or customize your own. Voice Prompts in multiple languages give you useful information like whether your battery is running low. feature_entries.title: 40 total hours of playback time, plus speed charging
feature_entries.description: Enjoy 10 hours of playtime, plus another three full charges (30 hours) in the charging case.* Need to recharge even faster? 10 minutes on a USB type-C charging cable will give you another three hours of playtime. (*with ANC off)

feature_entries.title: Multi-point connection
feature_entries.description: Pair your JBL Vibe Beam 2 earbuds with two Bluetooth devices at the same time and then switch effortlessly from one to the other. So if you're watching a video on your tablet, you won't miss a call on your mobile phone.

feature_entries.title: Seamless Bluetooth pairing
feature_entries.description: JBL Vibe Beam 2 come enabled with both Fast Pair by Google and Swift Pair by Microsoft, so they immediately pair with both your Android devices and Microsoft computer with a single tap.

products.title: Bose - QuietComfort Wireless Noise Cancelling Over-the-Ear Bluetooth Headphones - Sandstone
products.description: Take charge of your music with Bose QuietComfort Bluetooth headphones. These noise cancelling headphones come equipped with Quiet and Aware Modes that let you toggle between full noise cancelling or full awareness of your surroundings. Or create a custom mode on these Bluetooth headphones to adjust noise cancellation and add Wind Block to tune out breezy environments. Just press play on these over ear headphones for high-fidelity sound that’s also customizable with adjustable EQ. Use the Bose app to crank the bass, tweak the treble, and personalize your experience. Plus, these headphones with built in microphone are crafted with all-day wear and multi-taskers in mind. Available in striking colors, the premium materials and bold, iconic design combine comfort and style. On-ear toggles make switching from music to calls easy and the powerful battery means it’s ready for the long haul. Enjoy up to 24 hours of play time on a single charge with the Bose QC wireless headphones and up to 2.5 hours of play time with a quick 15-minute boost.

feature_entries.title: JBL Pure Bass Sound
feature_entries.description: Smartly designed 6mm drivers enhanced by the stick's form factor deliver JBL's Pure Bass Sound, so you'll feel every pulsing beat.

feature_entries.title: Bluetooth 5.3 with LE audio support (*)
feature_entries.description: Thanks to the next generation Bluetooth technology, the JBL Tune 245NC earbuds stream audio with low power consumption at high quality. Plus, BT 5.3 allows to stream synchronized audio independently to each earbud, so that you can use either or both earbuds. Or you can share your video or music content with a friend wearing headphones, as BT 5.3 lets you seamlessly stream audio to multiple listeners.

feature_entries.title: Active Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient
feature_entries.description: Hear more of what you want, less of what you don't. Active Noise Cancelling technology lets you minimize audio distractions. With Ambient Aware, you can tune into your surroundings at any time so that you feel safer when you're out in the world, while TalkThru lets you stop for a quick chat without having to remove your headphones.

feature_entries.title: 4-Mic technology for Crisp, Clear Calls
feature_entries.description: Enjoy hassle-free, hands-free calls in stereo. The Tune 245NC are equipped with dual microphones, so you'll always be heard with perfect clarity. Never hesitate to take or make a call again. And with VoiceAware, you can choose how much of your own voice to hear by controlling the amount of mic input routed back into your earbuds.

feature_entries.title: Up to 48 hours of battery life
feature_entries.description: Never miss a beat with 48 (12+36) hours of battery life or 10 hours, plus 30 hours in the case when noise cancelling is engaged. Need a boost? Speed Charge for just 15 minutes to get 4 hours of playtime.

feature_entries.title: Water and dust resistant
feature_entries.description: Don't be deterred by bad weather. Thanks to IP54 water resistance and dust proofing, there isn't a workout or downpour the Tune 245NC can't handle.

feature_entries.title: All-day fit & comfort
feature_entries.description: Never be without your music. The stick-closed 245NC design ensures good isolation sealing from the outside noises for a great sound performance and a secure, comfortable fit. The oval tube design snuggly adapts to your ear's ergonomics, ensuring a comfortable fit, natural blocking of outside noises and better sound quality.

feature_entries.title: JBL Headphones App
feature_entries.description: The JBL Headphones App lets you enjoy your music your way. Customize your listening experience and the touch control gestures, find your earbuds, control the environmental noise and the Smart Audio & Video modes. Download the App for free and discover how much more you can do.

products.page_description: The next generation of Crusher headphone is here. Crusher ANC 2 is loaded with everything you love about Crusher ANC plus Skull iQ Smart Feature Technology, Voice Control, Multipoint Pairing and much, MUCH more.

feature_entries.title: Skull-IQ Voice Control
feature_entries.description: Crusher ANC 2 is built with Skull-iQ, a powerful technology that runs innovative voice features and enables new upgrades via the Skull-iQ App. That means you won’t need to replace your beloved headphones to get the features.

feature_entries.title: Adjustable 4-Mic Active Noise Canceling
feature_entries.description: Crusher ANC 2 is equipped with premium, 4-mic active noise canceling that detects and cancels noise in the full range of sounds you can hear. Our advanced ANC is adjustable, too — so you can set your own custom level using a slider in the Skull-iQ App.

feature_entries.title: Adjustable Sensory Bass
feature_entries.description: Skullcandy Crusher is the original, one-and-only immersive sensory bass experience. Turn the adjustment wheel down for more mellow bass or turn it up to really rattle your bones. Crusher ANC 2 also features voice-controlled Crusher Bass.

feature_entries.title: Audio tuned to you
feature_entries.description: Everyone’s hearing is different — that’s why Crusher ANC 2 features Personal Sound. By taking a hearing test in the Skull-iQ App, you’ll create a sound pro?le, which Personal Sound technology uses to tune your headphones to your unique hearing.

feature_entries.title: Advanced Microphone Technology
feature_entries.description: Clear Voice Smart Mic processes audio inputs with the help of Arti?cial Intelligence, recognizing unwanted noise and removing it in real-time. Your voice will be heard with crystal clarity, regardless of your environment.

feature_entries.title: Pair with multiple devices
feature_entries.description: Multipoint Pairing makes it possible to pair your headphones to two devices at once. If your phone rings while you’re watching a video on your laptop, your connection will automatically switch so you can take the call.

feature_entries.title: Active Noise Cancelation
feature_entries.description: From airplane noise to people’s voices, our WH-1000XM5 wireless headphones with multiple microphone noise Cancelling keep out more high and mid frequency sounds than ever.

feature_entries.title: Magnificent sound, engineered to perfection
feature_entries.description: The light and rigid precision-engineered driver unit improves high frequency sensitivity for more natural sound quality.

feature_entries.title: Crystal clear hands-free calling
feature_entries.description: With Precise Voice Pickup Technology and advanced audio signal processing, the person on the other end of the call will hear your voice clearly, even when you are in noisy situations.

feature_entries.description: With up to 30 hours of battery life, you’ll have enough power even for long trips. If you need to charge in a hurry, you can get 3 hours' worth of charge after just 3 minutes with an additional USB-PD compatible AC adapter.

feature_entries.title: All day comfort with an elegant design
feature_entries.description: These lightweight headphones are beautifully finished in newly developed soft fit leather. This material fits snugly around the head with less pressure on the ears while keeping out external sounds.

feature_entries.title: Multipoint connection
feature_entries.description: For total convenience, these Bluetooth headphones can be paired with two Bluetooth devices at the same time. So when a call comes in, your headphones know which device is ringing and connects to the right one automatically.

feature_entries.description: As soon as you start a conversation, Speak-to-Chat automatically stops your music and lets in ambient sound – handy if you want to keep your headphones on or talk hands-free.

feature_entries.title: Instant pause. Instant play.

products.description: Redefine your possible with Shokz OpenRun Mini bone conduction headphones, formerly known as Aeropex, designed for endurance athletes. OpenRun Mini features a comfortable 0.83-inch smaller band than the standard size with all the same innovative features, making it ideal for smaller head sizes and those who prefer a more snug fit. For the past 10 years, Shokz has been dedicated to providing safety and situational awareness through bone conduction technology. Unlike traditional in-ear headphones, OpenRun features the signature Shokz open-ear design to keep you tuned in to your music and your moments. The enhanced audio features ensure clear sound, powerful volume, and a rich bass while you’re listening. OpenRun are both lightweight and durable for comfortable all-day use that can also withstand the elements. The IP67 waterproof rating makes OpenRun perfect for sweaty and rainy workouts, although they are not designed for underwater swimming. Embrace a new challenge powered by Shokz.

feature_entries.title: PremiumPitch 2.0+
feature_entries.description: Get the most out of your audio experience with clear sound, powerful volume, and a rich bass. OpenRun brings the next generation of sound preservation technology to your active lifestyle.

feature_entries.title: Comfortable and secure fit

products.page_description: To the music lovers with a playlist for every mood and moment, meet your new obsession. Bose designed earbuds with OpenAudio technology that combines complete openness to your surroundings with rich, private sound only you can hear. Get your run on, take a call, go all day. Do whatever your thing is and pause for nothing. Compromise? A word you don’t believe in. With Bose Immersive Audio, the open-ear headphones don’t just feel good and look good, they bring you closer to your music. Bose Immersive Audio spatializes music so you’re not only listening to the music. You’re in it. Are you ready to change the way you listen?

feature_entries.title: Open your ears to the world
feature_entries.description: Now with smoother ear-to-ear syncing and a more refined experience when not playing content. Hear all of what’s around you while enjoying rich, private sound. The earbuds' open-ear design says, “I can still hear you” while OpenAudio technology provides you with high-quality, private sound.

feature_entries.title: Be in the music —anywhere, everywhere.
feature_entries.description: Get your run on, take a call, go all day. Do whatever your thing is and pause for nothing. Bose Immersive Audio spatializes music so you’re not only listening to the music. You’re in it.

feature_entries.title: A sight for sore ears.
feature_entries.description: Designed for comfortable all-day wear, you'll put these on and never want to take them off. The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds feature a flexible joint and stable, light-as-air-grip – you’ll forget you’re even wearing them.

feature_entries.title: Stay charged and never miss a beat.
feature_entries.description: With up to 7 hours of play time (up to 4 hours with Immersive Audio)¹ or up to 48 hours of standby,² you’re equipped with the power of long-lasting battery life. Plus, the included charging case provides up to an extra 19.5 hours of power, making it perfect for on-the-go charging³.

feature_entries.title: Press, play, enjoy.
feature_entries.description: Simple, satisfying button controls make it super easy to switch between stereo and immersive modes, giving you instant command over your listening experience. With just a press, effortlessly control your music and answer calls. Plus, Auto Volume works like magic to keep your music audible even as the volume of your surroundings change. Just turn it on in the Bose app and move from place to place without needing to adjust a thing.

feature_entries.title: Water resistance with IPX4.
feature_entries.description: Get splashed on, dripped on, sprayed on. No worries here. The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds can handle it. Acoustic mesh keeps out moisture and debris, so you can keep on listening.

feature_entries.title: Plays nicely with other Bose products.
feature_entries.description: Indulge in TV time without bothering anyone. Thanks to Bose SimpleSync technology, you can pair your open-ear wireless headphones with Bose smart soundbars and speakers for a personal TV listening experience with independent volume control.

feature_entries.title: Seamless connection with advanced Bluetooth 5.3.
feature_entries.description: Now with improved Bluetooth connectivity and easier, quicker setup. Advanced Bluetooth 5.3 offers a strong, continuous connection within 30 feet of your device.

feature_entries.title: Control everything through the Bose app.
feature_entries.description: Take personalization even further with Adjustable EQ settings in the Bose app. Control bass, mid-range, and treble levels as you go. Or use the app to check battery life, customize a shortcut, and manage connected devices.

products.page_description: Elevate your journeys with soundcore Q20i headphones, your ultimate travel companion. Make long trips comfortable with memory foam ear cups and 40-hour battery life in noise cancelling mode. 40mm drivers produce thumping bass with Hi-Res certified audio. Enjoy added convenience with the soundcore app for a customizable EQ, transparency mode, dual-device connections, and crystal-clear calls with enhanced voice pickup.

feature_entries.title: Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling
feature_entries.description: 2 internal and 2 external mics work in tandem to detect external noise and effectively reduce up to 90% of it, such as planes and car engines.

feature_entries.title: Immerse Yourself in Detailed Audio
feature_entries.description: The noise cancelling headphones have oversized 40mm dynamic drivers that produce detailed sound and thumping beats with BassUp technology. Compatible with Hi-Res certified audio via the AUX cable for more detail.

feature_entries.title: 40-Hour Long Battery Life and Fast Charging
feature_entries.description: With 40 hours of battery life with ANC on and 60 hours in normal mode, you can commute in peace without thinking about recharging. Fast charge for 5 mins to get an extra 4 hours of playtime.

feature_entries.title: Dual- Connections
feature_entries.description: Connect to two devices simultaneously with Bluetooth 5.0 and instantly switch between them. Whether you're working on your laptop, or need to take a phone call, audio will automatically play from the device you need to hear from.

feature_entries.title: App for EQ Customization
feature_entries.description: Download the soundcore app to tailor your sound using the customizable EQ, with 22 presets, or adjust it yourself. You can also switch between 3 modes: ANC, Normal, and Transparency, and relax with white noise.

feature_entries.title: Hear Your Surroundings
feature_entries.description: Switch to Transparency mode on your noise cancelling headphones when you need to be aware of your surroundings, such as transportation announcements, crossing the road, or just staying connected to the world around you.

feature_entries.title: Reduce Noise By Up to 90%
feature_entries.description: soundcore Q20i noise cancelling headphones use hybrid active noise cancelling technology to effectively block out sounds in real-time.

feature_entries.title: Hi-Res Certified Audio
feature_entries.description: Hi-Res certified audio means that you can listen to wireless music of better quality than a CD. The large 40mm drivers can also produce crisp sound with thumping bass.

feature_entries.title: Soundcore App
feature_entries.description: Personalize your listening experience in the soundcore app with a customizable EQ, white noise for relaxation, and more.

feature_entries.title: Transparency Mode
feature_entries.description: Switch to transparency mode to connect with your surroundings without taking your noise cancelling headphones off. If you want some quiet, easily toggle between noise cancelling and normal mode as well.

feature_entries.title: Dual Device Connectivity
feature_entries.description: For extra convenience, connect up to two devices at the same time. The noise cancelling headphones will intelligently switch to the device that is playing audio.

feature_entries.title: Long Listening Comfort
feature_entries.description: Multi-angle rotatable ear cups allow you to wear your headphones at any angle. Breathable mesh keeps your ears sweat-free and memory foam cushions adapt to the shape of your ears for long-lasting comfort.

feature_entries.title: Hands-Free Calls
feature_entries.description: Incoming call but your hands are full? Just tap the button on your headphones and the built-in microphone will pick up your voice clearly for convenient conversation.

Buds3 Pro get how much you love your audio. From jamming while cooking to listening to your favorite show on a crowded subway to taking a work call, your Buds will adjust to the different sounds around you using Adaptive Active Noise Cancellation so you always hear what’s important. Plus, they’re packed with features to create a convenient listening experience — from auto-switching³ your audio between your Galaxy phone and your Galaxy PC to immersing you in the latest TV shows with 360 Audio, now available on Samsung TVs.⁴ And it doesn’t stop there — Buds make perfect companions for your Galaxy phone as you travel. Real-time Interpreter with Galaxy AI⁵ allows you to speak like a local as your phone translates speech right in your Buds so you never miss a word from your local tour guide. No matter what you listen to or how you listen, we’ve redesigned our Buds to give you a great immersive audio experience with Galaxy Buds3 Pro.

feature_entries.title: Redesigned with the best sound in mind
feature_entries.description: Listen in long-lasting comfort with an improved shape that delivers a snugt fit. Enjoy a completely new immersive listening experience and a fresh redesign your ears will love with Galaxy Buds3 Pro.

feature_entries.title: Audio that adapts to your surroundings
feature_entries.description: Enjoy quality sound that adapts to your surroundings when you’re listening to your Galaxy Buds3 Pro. feature_entries.title: Audio tailored to best fit you
feature_entries.description: Galaxy Buds3 Pro use Adaptive Equalizer with Galaxy AI⁶ to deliver high-quality sound based on how you wear them. Your Buds adjust your audio based on how they’re sitting in your ears to bring out the best in every playlist or podcast. That means you’ll get a personalized listening experience every time you put them in.

feature_entries.title: Immerse yourself in the sounds you love
feature_entries.description: Immerse yourself in audio with Crystal Sound on Galaxy Buds3 Pro.⁷ Designed for true audio lovers, these Buds deliver the high resolution experience your ears have been craving. From the bass of your playlist to the high note of your favorite singer, every sound comes through clearly in rich, vibrant detail.

feature_entries.title: They say “hola,” you hear “hello”
feature_entries.description: Engage in conversations in another language and easily ask for directions next time you travel abroad. Simply put in your Galaxy Buds3 Pro and Real-Time Interpreter with Galaxy AI⁸ will deliver live translations from your phone to your ears in crystal-clear clarity during face-to-face conversations.

feature_entries.title: From phone to ear, translations you can hear
feature_entries.description: From phoning a relative back home to calling in reservations while traveling abroad, break down language barriers with Galaxy Buds and Live Translate. Using the Samsung Phone app, you can hear real-time translations of your conversation clearly through your Buds.⁸

feature_entries.title: Touch controls with a personal touch
feature_entries.description: Give your listening experience a personal touch with Intuitive Touch Control⁹ on Galaxy Buds3 Pro. Tap into the convenience of controls that work the way you need them to — pause, skip tracks, accept calls and more with settings you can customize.

feature_entries.title: Your own personal theater experience
feature_entries.description: Enjoy your own personal theater experience at home with TV 360 Audio on Galaxy Buds3 Pro. From the latest shows to all the in-game action of your favorite football matchup, hear every detail on your TV with 360-degree immersive sound that feels like it’s all around you. Listen to what you want without interruption even while your friends are in the same room.¹⁰

feature_entries.title: Seamlessly switch your sound to your PC
feature_entries.description: Listen to the latest playlists on your Galaxy phone, then seamlessly switch to your laptop for the final boss battle of your favorite game using PC Auto Switch.¹¹ You’ll stay on beat in everything you do with Galaxy Buds3 Pro that switch automatically.

feature_entries.title: Designed for durability
feature_entries.description: Rock out with peace of mind thanks to the durable design of Galaxy Buds3 Pro. They’re built to last with resistance to accidental drops and moisture so you can stay in the groove with less worry.

feature_entries.title: A sleek design made to shine
feature_entries.description: Your Buds should shine as much as you do. We’ve added a brand-new way to stand out so everyone will know you’re rocking the 2024 Buds. Light up your listening experience with the Self Expression Light on Galaxy Buds3 Pro.⁹

products.page_description: AirPods Pro 2 - featuring pro-level Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Audio, Transparency mode, Personalized Spatial Audio, and a breakthrough in hearing health with a scientifically validated Hearing Test, clinical-grade Hearing Aid capability, and active Hearing Protection.

feature_entries.description: PIONEERING HEARING—AirPods Pro 2 unlock the world’s first all-in-one hearing health experience: a scientifically validated Hearing Test,⁴ clinical-grade Hearing Aid feature, and active Hearing Protection.⁵

INTELLIGENT NOISE CONTROL—Active Noise Cancellation removes up to 2x more background noise.¹ Transparency mode lets you hear the world around you, and Adaptive Audio seamlessly blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode for the best listening experience in any environment.² And when you’re speaking with someone nearby, Conversation Awareness automatically lowers the volume of what’s playing.⁶

IMPROVED SOUND AND CALL QUALITY—The Apple-designed H2 chip helps to create deeply immersive sound. The low-distortion, custom-built driver delivers crisp, clear high notes and full, rich bass in stunning definition. Voice Isolation improves the quality of phone calls in loud conditions.⁶

CUSTOMIZABLE FIT—Includes four pairs of silicone tips (XS, S, M, L) to fit a wide range of ear shapes and provide all-day comfort. The tips create an acoustic seal to help keep out noise and secure AirPods Pro 2 in place.
DUST, SWEAT, AND WATER RESISTANT—Both AirPods Pro 2 and the MagSafe Charging Case are IP54 dust, sweat, and water resistant, so you can listen comfortably in more conditions.⁷

PERSONALIZED SPATIAL AUDIO—With sound that suits your unique ear shape along with dynamic head tracking, AirPods Pro 2 deliver an immersive listening experience that places sound all around you.³ You can also listen to select songs, shows, and movies in Dolby Atmos.

A HIGHER LEVEL OF CONTROL—Simply swipe, press, and hold the stem to manage playback functions using Touch control. And with Siri Interactions, simply nod your head yes or shake your head no when Siri asks if you’d like to hear a message, answer a call, or manage a notification.⁶
LONG BATTERY LIFE—Get up to 6 hours of listening time with Active Noise Cancellation enabled. And get up to 30 hours of total listening time with Active Noise Cancellation enabled, using the case.⁹

A MORE CAPABLE CASE—Keep track of AirPods Pro 2 with Precision Finding and a built-in speaker.¹⁰ A lanyard loop helps keep your AirPods Pro 2 close. Charge with an Apple Watch or MagSafe charger, USB-C Charge Cable, or Qi-certified charger.¹¹

feature_entries.title: Dual Driver for Groundbreaking Audio Improvement
feature_entries.description: OpenRun Pro 2 redefines open-ear audio with DualPitch technology, blending bone conduction for clear mids and highs with air conduction for deep bass.

feature_entries.title: 3D Audio Perfection for Immersive Sound Experiences
feature_entries.description: Experience incredible 3D audio with a custom algorithm that assigns each sound element to a dedicated driver, creating a balanced, dynamic soundscape. DRC technology ensures distortion-free listening, even at peak volume.

feature_entries.title: Open-Ear Comfort
feature_entries.description: Featuring Shokz's open-ear design, the OpenRun Pro 2 keeps you aware of your surroundings while you work out, helping to improve safety and enhancing your listening experience. It optimizes volume range for clear audio even when you're on the go.

feature_entries.title: Leak-Free Audio
feature_entries.description: The bone conduction unit features an integrated design, encasing all components within a protective metal compartment helping to minimize sound leakage. Plus, DirectPitch technology further reduces air conduction unit leakage, delivering crystal-clear audio for you, and enhanced privacy.

feature_entries.title: Secure Fit
feature_entries.description: Engineered for the extremes, OpenRun Pro 2's ergonomic ear hooks and unibody frame provide a secure, comfortable fit that defies slips and adjustments. Experience unshakeable stability thanks to the weight-optimized design, while integrated Ni-Ti alloy memory wire delivers a clamping force that's secure without being uncomfortable – even during intense activities.

feature_entries.title: Cloud-Comfort Fit
feature_entries.description: Shokz's open-ear design and DualPitch technology reduce vibrations, making the headphones comfortable for extended wear. With a 4° core contact area and 16% reduction in clamping force, the headphones offer a feather-light fit and even pressure distribution.

feature_entries.title: IP55 Water-Resistant
feature_entries.description: Rain, sweat, splashes – bring it on. An IP55 water-resistant design, including a double-layer mesh structure and nano-hydrophobic coating, ensures durability against the elements.

feature_entries.title: AI Noise Reduction Algorithm for Crystal-Clear Call Quality
feature_entries.description: Enjoy crystal-clear communication with a cutting-edge AI noise reduction algorithm that filters out 96.5% of the chaos. Strategically positioned dual microphones capture even the subtlest inflections, ensuring your every word rings true, from bustling streets to noisy cafés.

feature_entries.title: Wind-Resistant Microphone
feature_entries.description: With a wind-resistant microphone and dual-balanced sound vents, OpenRun Pro 2 ensures clear communication even at speeds up to 25 km/h.

feature_entries.title: 12-Hour Battery Life + Quick Charge
feature_entries.description: Enjoy up to 12 hours of music playback with a larger battery that improves battery life and reduces power consumption, all without adding extra weight. And with Quick Charge, a 5-minute power boost gives you 2.5 hours of playtime.

feature_entries.title: Effortless USB-C Charging
feature_entries.description: The waterproof USB-C port allows easy charging with any cable. Dual protective layers and a secure cover provide a strong barrier against water while ensuring effortless recharging.

feature_entries.title: Shokz App
feature_entries.description: Install the Shokz App for more OpenRun Pro 2 functions and customization options. Use MultiPoint Pairing to seamlessly switch between 2 devices without pairing hassle. Enjoy 4 preset EQs to choose from, and 2 custom modes to tailor your experience.

feature_entries.title: Bluetooth 5.3
feature_entries.description: Equipped with the latest Bluetooth V5.3, OpenRun Pro 2 pairs instantly and maintains a stable connection within 10 m (32.8 ft).

feature_entries.title: Two Sizes for a Seamless Fit
feature_entries.description: Choose your perfect fit, standard or mini, for a comfortable listening experience.

products.description: When music means everything, there’s QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen). Because every listen deserves premium, personalized audio, the best Bose in-ear noise cancellation, and an entirely seamless earbud experience — so you can feel all the feels with each song you play.

source_listing.title: Bose - QuietComfort Ultra (2nd Gen) True Wireless Noise Cancelling In-Ear Earbuds - Black

products.page_description: When music means everything, there’s QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen). Because every listen deserves premium, personalized audio, the best Bose in-ear noise cancellation, and an entirely seamless earbud experience — so you can feel all the feels with each song you play.

feature_entries.title: Heart-stopping sound with each play.
feature_entries.description: CustomTune technology analyzes your ears and adapts the sound and noise cancelling to their unique shape. The result? World-class noise cancellation and sound tailored to you for more goosebumps and bigger chills every time you press play.

feature_entries.title: World-class noise cancellation.
feature_entries.description: When all you want is music, there’s the best noise cancelling of any Bose earbud. And now it’s even better than before. ActiveSense technology automatically smooths spikes in surrounding sound, so even in Aware Mode distractions won’t get in the way.

feature_entries.title: Modes put you in the moment.
feature_entries.description: Tune all the way in to totally jam out with the full noise cancellation of Quiet Mode. Or keep on top of your surroundings in Aware Mode for full transparency. There’s also Immersion Mode that blends noise cancelling with Bose Immersive Audio for the realest listening experience.

feature_entries.title: Immersive Audio. Feel the real.
feature_entries.description: A must-have for anyone serious about sound, Bose Immersive Audio spatializes what you’re hearing by taking it out of your head and placing beyond your earbuds. It’s like listening from the acoustic sweet spot, where songs sound like the artist intended and movies have theater-like levels of depth and realism.

feature_entries.title: Fit? Check.
feature_entries.description: Focus on the beat — not your buds. Choose from nine combinations of eartips and stability bands to find the most secure, snug fit. The soft, umbrella-shaped tips seal off the opening of your ear to reduce outside noises. And stability bands hug the contours of your ears for a fit that won’t quit.

feature_entries.title: Calls count, too.
feature_entries.description: Stay in touch while you’re out with the clearest phone calls. Noise-rejecting mics focus on your voice and AI-based background noise suppression filters out your surroundings and wind so you can be heard and hear it all. Take calls with both or a single earbud, whatever works for you.

feature_entries.title: Keep the music playing.
feature_entries.description: Play for up to 6 hours in Quiet or Aware Mode (up to 4 hours with Immersive Audio).* Running short on power? The case itself holds up to three additional full charges,** and recharging it is now easier than ever with new wireless capabilities.

feature_entries.title: Hands-free, hassle-free switching.
feature_entries.description: Bluetooth multipoint offers seamless, uninterrupted listening. Switch between your phone, your laptop, and other devices with ease — all without missing a moment.

feature_entries.title: Stay connected.
feature_entries.description: Advanced Bluetooth connectivity offers a strong, continuous connection within 30 feet of your device.

feature_entries.title: Swipe, tap, touch to get into the music.
feature_entries.description: Play or pause music, change the volume, and switch tracks with simple touch controls right on the earbuds themselves. You can even answer calls and cycle through modes, all without ever taking out your phone.

feature_entries.title: Control everything in the Bose app.
feature_entries.description: Take personalization to another level in the Bose app. Create a Custom Mode (such as combining Aware Mode and Immersive Audio) or use Adjustable EQ settings to dial in the sound. Control bass, mid-range, and treble levels as you go. The app also lets you check the battery life of your earbuds and case, customize a shortcut, and manage connected devices.

products.page_description: Obsessively engineered with Bose’s best noise cancellation for headphones and spatialized audio for immersive listening, the QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) make every note expand, every beat hit harder, and every melody take up more space. Sink deeper into your favorite songs and sounds with the ultimate combination of plush comfort, premium design, and seamless connectivity.

feature_entries.title: Awaken your sound.
feature_entries.description: Bose’s best noise cancellation for headphones with spatialized audio for more immersive listening — no matter the content or source. Premium design and luxe materials for unrivaled comfort so you can sink deeper into your favorite songs and sounds.

feature_entries.title: Super immersive. Super cinematic.
feature_entries.description: Bose Immersive Audio pushes the boundary of what it means to listen by taking what you’re hearing out of your head and placing it in front of you, putting you in the acoustic sweet spot. With new Cinema Mode, your favorite video content comes to life in a whole new way. Connect to your preferred device, and this feature spatializes and balances background sound delivering a movie-like experience wherever you go.

feature_entries.title: Silences noise.
feature_entries.description: Bose’s best noise cancellation for headphones let you do what you need to do, uninterrupted. The loud hum of an airplane? Annoying office chatter? TV playing in another room? Silenced.

feature_entries.title: Personalized, lossless sound.
feature_entries.description: The magic of CustomTune technology: it automatically analyzes your ears and adapts the sound performance of QC Ultra Headphones to their unique shape. The result? Sound that’s tailored and personalized to you. And now, with USB audio, you’ll experience crystal-clear, lossless sound that reveals every nuance — so you can hear your fave song like it’s the first time all over again.

feature_entries.title: Looks stylish. Feels luxurious.
feature_entries.description: Modern, sleek, sophisticated. With a new premium polish and refined metal materials, your listening experience just got more stylish. The plush cushions wrap your ears in a soft embrace while the headband evenly distributes pressure, ensuring a snug but comfortable fit all day long.

feature_entries.title: Outlasts the day.
feature_entries.description: QC Ultra Headphones provide up to 30 hours of play time on a single charge (up to 23 hours with Immersive Audio).* Need a quick boost? A 15-minute charge gives you up to 2.5 hours of battery life (up to 2 hours with Immersive Audio).** These headphones are great at multitasking — you can charge them with your USB cord and listen to music at the same time.

feature_entries.title: Crystal-clear phone calls.
feature_entries.description: No more “huh?” when you’re trying to just say “hello.” Noise-rejecting mics focus on your voice and AI-based background noise suppression filter out your surroundings and wind so you can be heard and hear it all.

feature_entries.title: Seamless control at your fingertips.
feature_entries.description: Press to play music or answer calls. Swipe for volume control. When you take your headphones off, your content pauses automatically — just put them back on to resume where you left off. Done listening? Lay the earcups flat to disconnect Bluetooth and let your headphones hibernate until your next session. Intuitive design makes using your headphones a breeze so you’ll always be in control.

feature_entries.title: Stay connected with advanced Bluetooth®.
feature_entries.description: Advanced Bluetooth® offers a strong, continuous connection within up to 30 feet of your device. Choose single or multi-point to keep your phone, tablet, and work or school computer paired, or just focus on one.

feature_entries.title: Control everything through the Bose app.
feature_entries.description: Want to immerse yourself but not block out the world? Create a Custom Mode for every listening moment. Turn off noise cancellation and combine Aware Mode with Immersive Audio to hear your surroundings while enhancing and adding depth to your music. Use the Adjustable EQ settings to dial in the sound. Control bass, mid-range, and treble levels as you go. Or use the app to check battery life, customize a shortcut, and manage connected devices.

products.page_description: Pure Bass. Zero Cables. The JBL Tune 520BT headphones stream powerful JBL Pure Bass sound thanks to the latest 5.3 BT technology. Easy to use, these headphones provide up to 57 hours of pure pleasure and an extra 3 hours of battery with just 5 minutes of charge. Download the free JBL Headphones App and customize your sound through the EQ, while Voice Prompts guide you through the headphone’s features. Manage calls, sound and volume from the earcup, thanks to the convenient button control. If a call comes in while you are watching a video on another device, the JBL Tune 520BT seamlessly switch to your mobile, so you never miss a call. lightweight and comfortable even after hours of listening, the JBL Tune 520BT headphones fold flat in your backpack to follow you everywhere.

feature_entries.description: Wirelessly stream high-quality sound from your smartphone without messy cords with the help of the latest bluetooth technology.

feature_entries.description: Easily control your sound and manage your calls from your headphones with the convenient buttons on the ear-cup. Hear your voice while talking, with the help of Voice Aware.

feature_entries.title: Ask Siri or Hey Google
feature_entries.description: Siri or Hey Google is just a button away: activate the voice assistant of your device by pushing the multi-function button.

products.page_description: OpenFit 2 brings you bigger, better, more dynamic open-ear sound with Shokz DualBoostTM Technology. With a comfortable, ergonomic design and an upgraded inner silicone layer, OpenFit 2 stays comfortable and securely in place. Manage calls, music, and everything else with physical buttons for precise control over your audio, and let the music move you.

feature_entries.title: DualBoostTM Technology for Dynamic Audio
feature_entries.description: OpenFit 2 introduces Shokz’s groundbreaking DualBoostTM Technology to deliver larger-than-life audio that's vibrant and dynamic. The 17.3mm customized composite dynamic drivers deliver deeper bass while the high-frequency unit delivers crisp, detailed sound.

feature_entries.title: Shokz OpenBass 2.0 Technology for Bold Bass
feature_entries.description: The advanced algorithm OpenBass 2.0 delivers powerful bass directly to your ears, while the Shokz App lets you customize your sound with 4 pre-set EQ modes or create your own with 2 custom EQs.

feature_entries.title: Golden Fit
feature_entries.description: Inspired by the perfect proportions of the golden spiral, OpenFit 2's flexible ear hook is optimized to ensure a secure fit. The integrated nickel-titanium alloy, molds to the contours of your ear for a personalized, comfortable fit from workouts to everyday wear.

feature_entries.title: Soft Comfort
feature_entries.description: At just 9.4g (0.33 oz) each, OpenFit 2 is incredibly lightweight, keeping your ears fatigue-free. Crafted with an inner layer of Shokz Ultra-Soft SiliconeTM 2.0, these earbuds provide a comfortable, natural fit that seamlessly blends into your everyday life.

feature_entries.title: Open-Ear Design for Situational Awareness
feature_entries.description: Stay in the game and connect to your world with our signature open-ear design and cutting-edge technology. Whether you’re on a city street, in the office, or at home, the OpenFit 2 helps you connect to the world around you while keeping you immersed in your audio.

feature_entries.title: Physical Multifunction Buttons
feature_entries.description: OpenFit 2's upgraded control functions combine physical buttons and touch controls for precise and intuitive operation. Easily adjust volume, skip tracks, answer calls, and more with a simple button press or touch.

feature_entries.title: 48 Hours of Battery Life + Quick Charge
feature_entries.description: Up to 48 hours of total listening time with the chaging case. Up to 11 hours of battery life with a single charge. A quick 10-minute charge delivers 2 hours of listening time.

feature_entries.title: AI-Powered Dual Noise-Canceling Microphones
feature_entries.description: Equipped with advanced noise-canceling technology, featuring dual microphones in each earbud and AI-powered beamforming, OpenFit 2 effectively filters out most environmental noise and provides crystal-clear call quality.

feature_entries.title: Easy MultiPoint Pairing
feature_entries.description: Seamlessly connect to two devices simultaneously with MultiPoint Pairing while the advanced Bluetooth 5.4 chip ensures fast, stable connectivity, whether you’re switching between your phone, tablet, watch, or computer.

feature_entries.title: Shokz App
feature_entries.description: Install the Shokz App for more OpenFit 2 functions and customization options. Easily locate your earbuds by using the “Find my Earbuds” function on the app. Personalize your favorite EQ modes and button functions, and access real-time power information and firmware updates via the Shokz App.
