products.page_description: Experience all-day comfort and open ear freedom with LinkBuds Clip earbuds. Enjoy natural sound, clear calls powered by AI, and three listening modes for every scene. With up to 37 hours of battery life, IPX4 water resistance, and effortless pairing, these earbuds keep you in tune with life—wherever it takes you.

feature_entries.title: Open Ear Design
feature_entries.description: Enjoy true open ear listening that keeps you connected to your surroundings while immersing you in your favorite music or podcast. Whether you’re at work, on the move, or relaxing at home, LinkBuds Clip earbuds let you stay aware of what’s happening around you without ever tuning out.

feature_entries.title: Secure and Comfortable Fit
feature_entries.description: Experience feather-light comfort and a secure, ergonomic fit designed for all-day wear. Customizable Pair with the Air Fitting Cushions to ensure the earbuds stay comfortably in place, so you can enjoy your music and calls without distraction.

feature_entries.title: Crystal Clear Calls, powered by AI
feature_entries.description: Take calls with confidence wherever you are, powered by advanced AI Voice Pickup Technology. Dual microphones and intelligent noise reduction algorithms work together to isolate your voice, filtering out background sounds—even in busy environments. A speech vibration sensor detects your voice through bone conduction, ensuring every conversation sounds natural and uninterrupted, whether you’re at home, in the office, or on the go.

feature_entries.title: Three listening modes
feature_entries.description: Easily adapt your listening experience to any environment with three tap-switchable modes: Standard for everyday use, Voice Boost for noisy places, and Sound Leakage Reduction for quiet settings. Just tap your earbuds to find the perfect sound for every moment.

feature_entries.title: Long Battery Life
feature_entries.description: Keep your music and calls going all day with up to 37 hours of battery life (up to 9 hours with the earbuds and up to 28 hours with the charging case). A quick 3-minute charge gives you up to an extra hour of listening, so you’re always ready for what’s next.

feature_entries.title: Multipoint Connection
feature_entries.description: Pair LinkBuds Clip earbuds with two Bluetooth devices simultaneously and switch between them effortlessly.Whether you’re listening to music on your laptop and taking a call on your phone, your earbuds automatically pause and resume playback for a seamless experience.

feature_entries.title: Adaptive Volume Control
feature_entries.description: Let your earbuds do the work—Adaptive Volume Control senses your environment and automatically adjusts the sound, ensuring comfortable listening whether you’re in a quiet room or a busy street.

feature_entries.title: IPX4 Water Rating
feature_entries.description: Don’t let splashes or sweat slow you down. With an IPX4 water resistance rating, LinkBuds Clip earbuds are built to handle your active lifestyle, keeping your music playing through workouts, commutes, and unpredictable weather.

feature_entries.title: Sound Connect app
feature_entries.description: Fine-tune your listening experience with the Sony | Sound Connect app. Adjust EQ settings, customize controls, and access advanced features to make your earbuds truly yours.

feature_entries.title: 360 Immersive Audio
feature_entries.description: Dive into immersive sound with 360 Reality Audio and Spatial Sound Personalization. Enjoy music that surrounds you and adapts to your unique ear shape for a truly personalized audio experience.

feature_entries.title: Intuitive Controls
feature_entries.description: Control your music and calls with simple taps—play, pause, adjust volume, or switch listening modes without reaching for your phone.

feature_entries.title: Sustainability
feature_entries.description: LinkBuds Clip earbuds are crafted with recycled materials and come in packaging free of plastic, reflecting Sony’s commitment to sustainability and reducing environmental impact.

feature_entries.title: Accessibility
feature_entries.description: Technology should be easy for everyone. LinkBuds Clip earbuds feature high-contrast packaging, embossed details with a QR code cutout, and an easy-open package and charging case, making setup and daily use simple for all abilities.

feature_entries.title: JBL Pure Bass Sound with Spatial Sound
feature_entries.description: JBL Tune Flex 2 earbuds feature 12mm dynamic drivers that deliver powerful JBL Pure Bass sound. feature_entries.title: Adaptive noise cancelling with Smart Ambient
feature_entries.description: JBL Tune Flex 2 earbuds use Adaptive Noise Cancelling to tune out noises entirely or just let in as much of the outside world you want. Ambient Aware adapts how much of the outside world you want to hear, while TalkThru lets you talk with those around you—all without taking your earbuds out. The additional eartips allow you to choose how much isolation from the outside world you want.

feature_entries.title: 6 mics for perfect calls and customized call experience

feature_entries.title: Personi-Fi 3.0
feature_entries.description: Hear and feel every note of your playlist. Shape your Audio to match your persona listening profile with interactive customization tools that use precise information about you and your preferences to provide the exact sound curve that suits you best.

feature_entries.title: 2 ear tip sound modes
feature_entries.description: Choose open ear tips to stay aware of your surroundings while wearing your earbuds. Or seal off the world and improve the passive noise cencelling with your choice of three sizes of sealing ear tip.

feature_entries.title: Multi-point connection + Fast Pair Enabled by Google
feature_entries.description: Effortlessly switch from one Bluetooth device to another- so if youre watching a video on your tablet, you won't miss a call on your mobile phone. JBL Tune Flex 2 come enabled with Fast Pair by Google, so you can pair your Android devices with a single tap.

feature_entries.title: Up to 48 Hours total playback
feature_entries.description: Enjoy up to 8 hours of playtime, plus another three full charges (24 hours) in the charging case with ANC on, or up to 12 hours plus 36 hours with ANC off.

feature_entries.title: The Music Stops When You Do
feature_entries.description: Less charging. More flexing. Beats Flex boasts up to 12 hours of listening time for all-day use. If you need a little extra power, 10-minute Fast Fuel charging gives 1.5 hours of playback when battery is low.²

feature_entries.title: Driven By Premium Sound
feature_entries.description: Beats Flex employs a dual-chamber acoustic design and a proprietary layered driver to achieve outstanding stereo separation with rich and precise bass response.

feature_entries.title: Make The Connection
feature_entries.description: Stay connected no matter where your day takes you. With Class 1 Bluetooth technology, Beats Flex offers extended wireless range and fewer dropouts.

feature_entries.title: Powered By The Apple W1 Chip
feature_entries.description: The Apple W1 chip seamlessly integrates Beats Flex into your world of Apple products. Simply power on and hold near your iPhone or iPad.³

From there, your Beats Flex are ready to be used with any Apple device that is synced to iCloud so you can seamlessly switch between products, check battery status, or share whatever you're listening to with someone else via Audio Sharing.

feature_entries.title: Listen With A Friend
feature_entries.description: Audio Sharing lets you wirelessly share audio with Beats Flex and another pair of Beats headphones⁴ or airpods. From a song, to a podcast, or even a movie - some things are better together.

Now you can easily share whatever you're listening to on an iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV and each control your own volume. Simply bring the second set of compatible Bluetooth headphones near your Apple device and connect with a tap. All that's left to do is listen - together.

feature_entries.title: Compatible With Android
feature_entries.description: Beats Flex are compatible with Android devices and easily connects via Bluetooth. With the Beats app, available for download in the Google Play Store, you'll get features like quick-pairing, device status (i.e. Battery levels), and firmware updates.
And the USB-C charge connector provides a single charging solution across both Android and Apple platforms.

feature_entries.title: JBL Pure Bass Sound with Spatial Sound
feature_entries.description: JBL Tune Buds 2 earbuds feature 10mm dynamic drivers that deliver powerful JBL Pure Bass sound. And whether you're listening to your favorite playlist, watching a movie, or playing a game, JBL Spatial Sound transforms the stereo sound from any source or device into a more immersive sound experience.

feature_entries.title: Adaptive noise cancelling with Smart Ambient
feature_entries.description: JBL Tune Buds 2 earbuds use Adaptive Noise Cancelling to tune out noises entirely or just let in as much of the outside world you want. Ambient Aware adapts how much of the outside world you want to hear, while TalkThru lets you talk with those around you—all without taking your earbuds out.

feature_entries.title: 6 mics for perfect calls and customized call experience
feature_entries.description: Two beamforming outer mics on each earbud pick up your voice and deliver it as clearly as possible, while one inner mic isolates noise. Use the JBL Headphones app to customize what you and the people you're talking to sound like through your earbuds.

feature_entries.title: Personi-Fi 3.0
feature_entries.description: Hear and feel every note of your playlist. Shape your audio to match your personal listening profile with interactive customization tools that use precise information about you and your preferences to provide the exact sound curve that suits you best.

feature_entries.title: Up to 48 hours total playback
feature_entries.description: Enjoy up to 10 hours of playtime, plus another three full charges (30 hours) in the charging case with ANC on, or up to 12 hours plus 36 hours with ANC off.

feature_entries.title: IP54 dust and water resistant*

feature_entries.title: Multi-point connection + Fast Pair enabled by Google
feature_entries.description: Effortlessly switch from one Bluetooth device to another—so if you're watching a video on your tablet, you won't miss a call on your mobile phone. JBL Tune Buds 2 come enabled with Fast Pair by Google, so you can pair your Android devices with a single tap.

feature_entries.title: JBL headphones app
feature_entries.description: Personalize the soundtrack of your life. Just download the free JBL Headphones app to customize the way you listen. You can also change how the earbuds behave through gesture customization, or adapt the sound output to audio or video to get the most out of your content—plus much more.

products.page_description: OpenFit Air inherits the Shokz open-ear design, providing you with enhanced fitting comfort and steadiness thanks to the exclusive Shokz Air-Ear hook. Listen to your playlist with a well-balanced sound for workout routines and day-to-day life.

feature_entries.title: Hooked on Comfort
feature_entries.description: Wobble-free, Snug Fit Featuring our signature open-ear design, an adaptable ear hook for improved comfort, and weighing only 8.7g*, it’s not just what you want; it's what you didn't know you needed. Got the rhythm? Go ahead and move - your earbuds won’t budge. Featuring an ultra-fine 0.75mm flexible Ni-Ti memory alloy with a soft silicone finish, our Air-Earhook design keeps your earbuds snugly in place.

feature_entries.title: Pressure Points? Not Here.
feature_entries.description: Slip into comfort mode with our thoughtfully crafted ear hooks. Designed with a teardrop-shaped cross-section, the larger lower part minimizes pressure during long listening sessions, and the smaller top section allows you to wear glasses effortlessly with your earbuds.

feature_entries.title: Flex Mode On
feature_entries.description: We just made ear hooks better with a pliable cutout design that folds around the curves of every ear — practically like a shape-shifter. And the bigger contact area adds an extra layer of stability to the mix.

feature_entries.title: Ergonomic Dual-Bevel Design
feature_entries.description: Meet the OpenFit Air’s ergonomic dual-bevel design. Through extensive studies and tests, Shokz engineered a steadfast, secure, stable fit. By shifting the center of gravity closer to the ear, we've created a lighter-than-air feel that practically defies movement. It's not just comfort; it's peace of mind. Slimmed down to perfection, the beveled driver housing doesn't just look good; it enables the earbuds to fit deeper in your ear for a comfortably snug fit.

feature_entries.title: Sounds so Good
feature_entries.description: Packed with a custom dynamic driver unit, the OpenFit Air delivers sound akin to a 16mm prototype, while the composite diaphragm ensures balanced highs, mids, and bass. Paired with built-in Dynamic Range Control (DRC), EQ levels adapt in real-time, hitting all the right notes. Personalize your sound even more with the Shokz App and four preset EQ modes.

feature_entries.title: Smart Bass Vibes
feature_entries.description: With Shokz OpenBass Air, our proprietary low-frequency enhancement, these earbuds bring deep bass and detailed richness without unnecessary fuss. Positioned to vibe with your ear canal, they're all about that perfect bass.

feature_entries.title: Beauty Meets Beats
feature_entries.description: Meticulously crafted, OpenFit Air radiates vitality with elegance. products.page_description: JBL Live 670NC headphones deliver powerful JBL Signature Sound in a comfortable on-ear headband style. When you're deep in your flow, True Adaptive Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient technology keeps you free from distractions. Then, when you want to keep an ear open to the world around you, you can stay aware as you continue listening to your favorite playlist—or even have a conversation without taking the headphones off. Easily access your preferred voice assistant with a tap on the ear cup to cue up a song, text your friend, check the weather, and much more. You’ll enjoy 65 hours (50 hours with BT+ANC on) of music streaming. And if you still need more, a 5-minute speed charge gets you another four hours. The JBL Live 670NC can connect with two Bluetooth devices simultaneously, so you’ll never have to miss a call, even if you’re watching a movie on your tablet.

feature_entries.title: JBL Signature Sound And Surround Sound
feature_entries.description: Along with powerful JBL signature sound, the 40mm drivers offer immersive JBL Spatial Sound that turns any stereo content from any device into virtual surround sound.

feature_entries.title: Bluetooth 5.3 With Le Audio Supported
feature_entries.description: Wirelessly stream high-quality sound even at lower bit rates with the help of the latest Bluetooth technology. Audio Mode gets you the best available sound, while Video Mode makes sure the sound and visuals of your movies and games are always in sync.

feature_entries.title: True Adaptive Noise Cancelling With Smart Ambient
feature_entries.description: With four noise-sensing mics, true adaptive noise cancelling means zero distractions, whether it's time to focus on your studies or get lost in the groove. And if you want to hear the world around you without removing your headphones, Smart Ambient sharpens the sounds of your surroundings.

feature_entries.title: Up To 65 Hours** Of Battery Life And Speed Charge
feature_entries.description: For long-lasting fun, listen wirelessly for up to 50 hours and recharge the battery in as little as 2 hours with the convenient Type-C USB cable. And if you're in a hurry, a quick 5-minute recharge gives you 4 additional hours of music.

feature_entries.title: Auto Play And Pause
feature_entries.description: Take the headphones off, the music stops. Put it back on, the music starts again. It genuinely couldn't be simpler.

feature_entries.title: Ask Alexa Or Hey Google
feature_entries.description: Alexa or Hey Google is always standing by. Activate your device's voice assistant just by using their hotword or tapping the earcup.

feature_entries.title: Multi-Point Connection
feature_entries.description: Effortlessly switch from one Bluetooth device to another. Jump from a video on your tablet to a call on your mobile phone, and never miss a moment.

feature_entries.title: Seamless Connectivity With Any Device
feature_entries.description: Whether you're using an Android or Windows device, it's easy to set up your headphones to automatically pair with it whenever it's nearby. And with the new Google Finder service, if you ever misplace your headband, you've got a network of over 3 million Android pals who'll automatically help you find it.

feature_entries.title: 2 Beamforming Microphones For Calls
feature_entries.description: Your friends, family, and co-workers will hear every word you say—even if you're outside and it's windy.

feature_entries.title: Comfort-Fit Fabric Headband And Carrying Pouch
feature_entries.description: Soft ear cushions and a textured, fabric headband in earthly shades make these headphones comfortable and unique. And when you do take them off, they have a comfy and protective place to live that's easy to pull out of your bag.

feature_entries.title: Jbl Headphones App
feature_entries.description: Control the soundtrack of your life. The free JBL Headphones app allows you to tailor your headphones' preferences, like customizing the ANC, personalize the headphones' behaviors or quickly set up amazingly realistic sound for your movies, music, and games.

feature_entries.title: Personi-Fi 2.0
feature_entries.description: The My JBL Headphones app personalizes your sound experience just for you. Just take the quick and easy hearing test and it automatically sets up a custom sound profile that's ready to go every time you put on your headband. That's it.
Available via OTA update at a later stage.

products.page_description: Get loud on the go. Motif II A.N.C. offers huge sound, in a tiny package. Its sleek charging case packs a punch by powering your headphones with 30 hours playtime to be unleashed whenever you want. With active noise cancellation, block out those crowded train rides and rowdy streets to dive into your music without distraction. feature_entries.title: Marshall Signature Sound

Feel secure knowing that when this next-generation Bluetooth technology is released, your headphones can more than handle it.

feature_entries.description: Motif II A.N.C. comes with improved battery preservation, while its case and buds are made from 70% post-consumer recycled plastic, including used electronics, water bottles and automotive light covers.

feature_entries.title: On The Go Charging

feature_entries.title: Comfortable Fit

feature_entries.title: Open-ear design
feature_entries.description: The Shokz signature open-ear design is powered by patented bone conduction technology. The design allows you to stay open to your surroundings while listening to your audio favorites for environmental safety and awareness.

feature_entries.title: PremiumPitch 2.0+
feature_entries.description: Get the most out of your audio experience with clear sound, powerful volume, and a rich bass. OpenRun brings the next generation of sound preservation technology to your active lifestyle.

feature_entries.title: Comfortable and secure fit
feature_entries.description: OpenRun’s titanium wraparound band ensures a comfortable fit, and keeps your headphone securely in place — no matter how intense your workout.

feature_entries.title: Lightweight
feature_entries.description: At only 26g, the OpenRun headphones are extremely lightweight, making them perfect for all-day wear.

feature_entries.title: IP67 waterproof rating
feature_entries.description: OpenRun headphones are designed to weather even the harshest workout conditions. The IP67 rating means they’re dirt-proof, sweat-resistant, and will withstand submersion in 1 meter of water for up to 30 minutes. OpenRun are not intended for swimming.

feature_entries.title: Dual noise-canceling mic
feature_entries.description: Answer calls on-the-go with the precisely placed dual noise-canceling microphones. They exclude surrounding noise, effectively enhancing speech for crystal-clear calls and simple hands-free chatting via a compatible device.

feature_entries.title: Bluetooth v5.1
feature_entries.description: Pair open-ear listening with your favorite music streaming devices for easy wireless listening. OpenRun’s updated Bluetooth capabilities support HFP, HSP, A2DP and AVRCP Bluetooth profiles.

feature_entries.title: Moisture detection alert
feature_entries.description: To keep your OpenRun in top shape, your device will alert you if the headphones are plugged into the charger while wet. Follow the prompt to remove the headphones from the charger for optimal battery life.

Bose designed earbuds with OpenAudio technology that combines complete openness to your surroundings with rich, private sound only you can hear. Get your run on, take a call, go all day. Do whatever your thing is and pause for nothing. Compromise? A word you don’t believe in. With Bose Immersive Audio, the open-ear headphones don’t just feel good and look good, they bring you closer to your music. Bose Immersive Audio spatializes music so you’re not only listening to the music. You’re in it. Are you ready to change the way you listen?

feature_entries.title: Open your ears to the world
feature_entries.description: Now with smoother ear-to-ear syncing and a more refined experience when not playing content. Hear all of what’s around you while enjoying rich, private sound. feature_entries.title: Be in the music —anywhere, everywhere.
feature_entries.description: Get your run on, take a call, go all day. Do whatever your thing is and pause for nothing. Bose Immersive Audio spatializes music so you’re not only listening to the music. You’re in it.

feature_entries.title: A sight for sore ears.
feature_entries.description: Designed for comfortable all-day wear, you'll put these on and never want to take them off. The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds feature a flexible joint and stable, light-as-air-grip – you’ll forget you’re even wearing them.

feature_entries.title: Stay charged and never miss a beat.

feature_entries.title: Water resistance with IPX4.
feature_entries.description: Get splashed on, dripped on, sprayed on. No worries here. The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds can handle it. Acoustic mesh keeps out moisture and debris, so you can keep on listening.

feature_entries.title: Plays nicely with other Bose products.
feature_entries.description: Indulge in TV time without bothering anyone. Thanks to Bose SimpleSync technology, you can pair your open-ear wireless headphones with Bose smart soundbars and speakers for a personal TV listening experience with independent volume control.

feature_entries.title: Seamless connection with advanced Bluetooth 5.3.

feature_entries.title: Control everything through the Bose app.

The secure, ergonomic fit with a weight-optimized frame guarantees stability without sacrificing comfort, even during intense workouts.

feature_entries.title: Dual Driver for Groundbreaking Audio Improvement
feature_entries.description: OpenRun Pro 2 redefines open-ear audio with DualPitch technology, blending bone conduction for clear mids and highs with air conduction for deep bass.

feature_entries.title: 3D Audio Perfection for Immersive Sound Experiences
feature_entries.description: Experience incredible 3D audio with a custom algorithm that assigns each sound element to a dedicated driver, creating a balanced, dynamic soundscape. DRC technology ensures distortion-free listening, even at peak volume.

feature_entries.title: Open-Ear Comfort
feature_entries.description: Featuring Shokz's open-ear design, the OpenRun Pro 2 keeps you aware of your surroundings while you work out, helping to improve safety and enhancing your listening experience. It optimizes volume range for clear audio even when you're on the go.

feature_entries.title: Leak-Free Audio
feature_entries.description: The bone conduction unit features an integrated design, encasing all components within a protective metal compartment helping to minimize sound leakage. Plus, DirectPitch technology further reduces air conduction unit leakage, delivering crystal-clear audio for you, and enhanced privacy.

feature_entries.title: Secure Fit
feature_entries.description: Engineered for the extremes, OpenRun Pro 2's ergonomic ear hooks and unibody frame provide a secure, comfortable fit that defies slips and adjustments. Experience unshakeable stability thanks to the weight-optimized design, while integrated Ni-Ti alloy memory wire delivers a clamping force that's secure without being uncomfortable – even during intense activities.

feature_entries.title: Cloud-Comfort Fit
feature_entries.description: Shokz's open-ear design and DualPitch technology reduce vibrations, making the headphones comfortable for extended wear. With a 4° core contact area and 16% reduction in clamping force, the headphones offer a feather-light fit and even pressure distribution.

feature_entries.title: IP55 Water-Resistant
feature_entries.description: Rain, sweat, splashes – bring it on. An IP55 water-resistant design, including a double-layer mesh structure and nano-hydrophobic coating, ensures durability against the elements.

feature_entries.title: AI Noise Reduction Algorithm for Crystal-Clear Call Quality
feature_entries.description: Enjoy crystal-clear communication with a cutting-edge AI noise reduction algorithm that filters out 96.5% of the chaos. Strategically positioned dual microphones capture even the subtlest inflections, ensuring your every word rings true, from bustling streets to noisy cafés.

feature_entries.title: Wind-Resistant Microphone
feature_entries.description: With a wind-resistant microphone and dual-balanced sound vents, OpenRun Pro 2 ensures clear communication even at speeds up to 25 km/h.

feature_entries.title: 12-Hour Battery Life + Quick Charge
feature_entries.description: Enjoy up to 12 hours of music playback with a larger battery that improves battery life and reduces power consumption, all without adding extra weight. And with Quick Charge, a 5-minute power boost gives you 2.5 hours of playtime.

feature_entries.title: Effortless USB-C Charging
feature_entries.description: The waterproof USB-C port allows easy charging with any cable. Dual protective layers and a secure cover provide a strong barrier against water while ensuring effortless recharging.

feature_entries.title: Shokz App
feature_entries.description: Install the Shokz App for more OpenRun Pro 2 functions and customization options. Use MultiPoint Pairing to seamlessly switch between 2 devices without pairing hassle. Enjoy 4 preset EQs to choose from, and 2 custom modes to tailor your experience.

feature_entries.title: Bluetooth 5.3
feature_entries.description: Equipped with the latest Bluetooth V5.3, OpenRun Pro 2 pairs instantly and maintains a stable connection within 10 m (32.8 ft).

feature_entries.title: Two Sizes for a Seamless Fit
feature_entries.description: Choose your perfect fit, standard or mini, for a comfortable listening experience.

products.description: Introducing the soundcore Sleep A20, your ultimate companion for restorative sleep. Engineered with a cutting-edge 4-point noise masking system, it delivers unparalleled tranquility by drowning out disturbances with precision. Powered by soundcore's exclusive Twin-Seal ear tips, the Sleep A20 offers 3 times stronger passive noise blocking, effectively sealing off external disruptions. This innovative design ensures a snug fit while providing an extra layer of protection precisely at the entrance to the ear canal. This means it's 3 times more effective than single-layer ear tips at blocking out unwanted noise. Designed to combat deep snores and other common disturbances, choose from a variety of white noise options or soundcore Acoustic Lab noise-masking solutions. Smart Volume Control automatically adjusts to maintain a peaceful environment throughout the night. Crafted for side sleepers, the Sleep A20 features pressureless comfort wrapped in ultra-soft material that covers 100% of the contact area with your ear's concha. Its ergonomic design seamlessly adapts to your ear shape, while the exclusive Air Wing design evenly distributes pressure for uninterrupted comfort. Tailor your experience with 3 sizes of ear wings and the option to switch between Sealed or Breathable ear tips, ensuring the perfect fit for your ears. With up to 10 nights of deep sleep on a single charge and 80 hours of usage with the fully charged case, the soundcore Sleep A20 is your reliable companion from nightfall to sunrise. Experience the bliss of uninterrupted sleep with the Soundcore sleep A20—your gateway to a well-rested mind and body.

feature_entries.title: Waterproof and dustproof
feature_entries.description: The JBL Endurance Race 2 is made for your toughest workout. Their IP68 rating means they're fully dustproof and waterproof, with complete protection against solid particles and the ability to survive being submerged deeper than a meter in both fresh water and sea water. Even the charging case is IPX2 water-resistant, so it can come along on your next rainy-day run.

feature_entries.title: Ergonomic wing enhancer with Twistlock technology
feature_entries.description: The ergonomic wing enhancer on the JBL Endurance Race 2 earbuds uses Twistlock technology. That means a better seal and with more stability in your ears when you're using them, not to mention all-day comfort.

feature_entries.title: Enhance your work-out with Sports Mode
feature_entries.description: Use the JBL Headphones app to match your workout with ANC, Ambient Aware and EQ. Adjust the settings to the intensity of your workout, choosing one of the six default Sports Modes - or you can customize your own. And when your workout is over, chill out and recharge in Relax Mode by choosing one of five peaceful sounds, like gentle ocean waves or a crackling wood fire.

feature_entries.title: Active Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient
feature_entries.description: JBL Endurance Race 2 earbuds use Active Noise Cancelling to listen to your surroundings and filter out distracting noise. feature_entries.title: 4 mics for crisp, clear calls

feature_entries.title: JBL Pure Bass sound

feature_entries.title: Seamless Bluetooth pairing
feature_entries.description: JBL Endurance Race 2 come enabled with both Fast Pair by Google and Swift Pair by Microsoft, so you can pair both your Android devices and Microsoft computer with a single tap.

feature_entries.title: A next-gen Smart Charging Case for a seamless listening experience
feature_entries.description: Leave your phone in your pocket. JBL Tour Pro 3’s newly redesigned Smart Charging CaseTM has all the features you need to fully control and customize your listening experience and the earbuds settings in multiple languages, right from the case. Use the bigger, clearer 1.57” touchscreen to see what song is playing or who’s calling you. Check the dynamic lock screen to get info on battery life status, time, messages etc.

feature_entries.title: Use the Smart Charging Case for everywhere entertainment
feature_entries.description: The Smart Charging Case transforms into a dongle to wirelessly transmit audio to the earbuds from any AUX or USB-C source, such as TV, gym or plane entertainment systems. Just use one of the two included audio cables to connect and enjoy. Or use the Auracast button on the display to share your content to any nearby devices by connecting the device through the Tour Pro 3 Smart Charging Case.

feature_entries.title: Legendary JBL Pro sound with hybrid dual-driver
feature_entries.description: JBL Tour Pro 3 features dual drivers in each earbud. The balanced armature driver handles the high notes with enchanting clarity, while an 11mm dynamic driver provides clean, powerful bass and vivid, lifelike vocals. They also deliver Hi-Res certified audio wirelessly with LDAC, Android’s native 24-bit high-resolution audio codec, delivering three times more data than Bluetooth for exceptional audio quality.

feature_entries.title: Immersive JBL Spatial 360 sound with Head Tracking
feature_entries.description: Whether you're listening to your favorite playlist, watching a movie, or playing a game, JBL Spatial 360 sound transforms stereo sound from any source or any device into a truly immersive sound experience. And when you turn on Head Tracking, everything will sound even more natural and realistic—sounds feel like they come from outside your head and stay fixed in space.

feature_entries.title: True Adaptive Noise Cancelling 2.0, real time calibration and custom control
feature_entries.description: JBL Tour Pro 3 earbuds listen to your surroundings and adjust themselves in real time, so even the loudest sudden noise won't disturb your flow. Use the JBL Headphones app to adjust how much or how little of the outside world you let in. An additional set of foam ear tips allows even better passive isolation.

feature_entries.title: 6 mics for perfect call with JBL Crystal AI Algorithm
feature_entries.description: Two beamforming outer mics on each earbud, powered by JBL Crystal AI algorithm, pick up your voice and deliver it as clearly as possible, while one inner mic isolates noise. The windproof design means minimal distortion, even if you’re outside on a windy day. Call equalizer helps control exactly how you sound to others and how you want them to sound to you. And sound level optimizer helps you bring down loud talkers or turn up quiet talkers.

feature_entries.title: A personalized sound experience
feature_entries.description: Hear and feel every note of your playlist with Personi-Fi 3.0. Shape your audio to match your personal listening profile with interactive customization tools that use precise information about you and your preferences to provide the exact sound curve that suits you best. Or for even more personalization, turn on the Personal Sound Amplification feature to adjust the left and right earbuds balance and amplify the conversations' volume up to +15-20dB.

feature_entries.title: Automatically connect to the world around you or have a chat
feature_entries.description: Stay alert to the sounds of the world around you while enjoying your music with Smart Ambient. Customized Ambient Sound raises and lowers the volume in real time, depending on how quiet or noisy your surroundings are. Smart Talk recognizes your voice, automatically pausing the music and enabling your preferred ambient experience whenever you speak.

feature_entries.title: Stay in control with the JBL Headphones app
feature_entries.description: Download the JBL Headphones app to customize EQ, switch on Adaptive Noise Cancelling, adjust your ambient sound control settings, check your best fit, or find your earbuds. Adjust how the earbuds behave through the gesture customization or adapt the sound output to audio or video to match your needs. Customize the Smart Charging Case to display one of your photos as a wallpaper, choose the screen language, and select feature shortcuts for your case.

feature_entries.title: Up to 44 hours of music playback
feature_entries.description: Enjoy 11 hours of music plus three more full charges with ANC off (11+33H), or 8 hours plus three more full charges with ANC on (8+24H). And you can always get an additional three hours of listening with a quick 10-minute speed charge. The JBL Tour Pro 3 can be recharged wirelessly.

feature_entries.title: Fast Pair enabled by Google and Microsoft swift pair
feature_entries.description: Discover Bluetooth accessories in close proximity to your device—then connect with a single tap. With Microsoft sift pair you can seamlessly pair your Bluetooth devices with your Windows 10 PC.

feature_entries.title: Bluetooth 5.3 LE audio (*)
feature_entries.description: The JBL Tour Pro 3 feature Bluetooth 5.3, for a more stable and secure connection, so that you can enjoy wireless connection at its best. Featuring the last Bluetooth technology, your JBL Tour Pro 3 become virtually futureproof. Also, the Tour Pro 3 audio transmitter Smart Charging Case supports Auracast, so that you can share your audio with anyone near you. Available via OTA update

products.title: Sony - PULSE Explore wireless earbuds - Midnight Black
products.description: Enjoy extraordinary lifelike sound at home and on the go with the PULSE Explore wireless earbuds. Discover a new era of gaming audio as studio-inspired planar magnetic drivers reproduce soundscapes with ultra-low distortion to deliver rich details and enable you to hear exactly what the game developers intended. Feel the action with clear deep bass, and elevate your perception with more precise positioning of audio cues in 3D Audio supported PS5 games. Never miss a beat as new ultra-low latency and lossless PlayStation Link wireless technology delivers sound at lightning-fast speed without losing a single audible detail in the process. Easily connect and switch between PlayStation Link compatible devices, including your PS5 console, PC or Mac and PlayStation Portal remote player. Ensure friends hear your voice loud and clear through two hidden microphones equipped with AI-enhanced noise rejection technology, while easy-access volume controls let you keep your eyes on the game. Take the PULSE Explore wireless earbuds on your adventures thanks to its light, portable form factor that offers up to 5 hours of play on a single charge. Plus, get back into the action even when you’re away from home with the included charging case that offers up to 10 hours of additional battery life.

products.page_description: The BlueParrott M300-XT SE Bluetooth driving earpiece headset is designed for superior calls in high-noise environments. Featuring 80% noise cancellation with 2-mic tech, our earpiece for drivers provides 14 hours of talk time on a single charge for those who work long shifts. Our ultra lightweight earpiece weighs just 0.7 oz., making it an excellent option for those who work on the road delivering packages, food delivery drivers, taxi drivers, ride-share drivers, limo drivers, and anyone who drives for a living. In addition, our driving headset earpiece is reversible so that you can wear it on whichever side you prefer. With a wireless range of 300 feet (100 meters), our blue tooth headset for work ensures you can leave your phone in your vehicle as you're dropping off orders, ideal for local truckers, remote workers, or anyone on-the-go. Simply program it with your most-used function for instant access without taking your eyes off the road. The wireless earpiece pairs with up to 8 devices, with 2 simultaneous connections, and provides 420 hours of standby time.

feature_entries.title: Audiophile tuning

products.page_description: WHCH720N Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones

feature_entries.title: Headphones that let you fully immerse yourself in the music
feature_entries.description: Dual Noise Sensor Technology and an Integrated Processor V1 takes noise cancelling to the next level. Now you can fully immerse yourself in the music.

feature_entries.title: Designed with all-day comfort
feature_entries.description: Designed to be Sony’s lightest wireless Noise Cancelling headphones yet. Featuring a slimmer, lightweight headband, these headphones have been re-structured to create more space and comfort for the ears. Making them the ideal headphones to work from home or movie.

feature_entries.title: Adjustable Ambient Sound mode
feature_entries.description: Adjustable Ambient Sound mode offers 20 level settings. You’ll be able to listen to your music with incredible sound quality while still hearing sounds like traffic noise, café conversations, and transport announcements.

feature_entries.title: Adaptive Sound Control automatically adjusts to whatever you do
feature_entries.description: Adaptive Sound Control is a smart function that senses where you are and what you’re doing, then adjusts ambient sound settings for the ideal listening experience.

feature_entries.title: Listen longer with up to 35-hour battery life and Quick Charging
feature_entries.description: Keep your music playing all day with a battery life that delivers up to 35 hours of power. USB Type-C quick charging gives up to 60 mins of play back from 3 minutes of charge.

feature_entries.title: Give your music a boost with DSEE
feature_entries.description: DSEE (Digital Sound Enhancement Engine) restores high-frequency elements and fine fade-out sound to produce high-quality sound that’s closer to the original recording.

feature_entries.title: Customize your sound, just how you like it
feature_entries.description: The EQ Custom feature on the Sony | Headphones Connect App tailors sound to your personal preference. Choose from a variety of presets to match sound quality with the genre of music you're listening to. Or create and save your own presets.

feature_entries.title: So immersive. So real.
feature_entries.description: Immerse yourself in sound all around you. As real as if you are there at a live concert or with the artist recording in a studio. With 360 Reality Audio, music has never been so immersive and so real.

feature_entries.title: Precise Voice Pickup Technology with Beam Forming Mic
feature_entries.description: Precise Voice Pickup Technology uses beamforming microphones to allow WH-CH720N headphones to pick up voices clearly and accurately for hands-free calls.

feature_entries.title: Multipoint Connection
feature_entries.description: For total convenience, these Bluetooth headphones can be paired with two Bluetooth devices at the same time. So when a call comes in, your headphones know which device is ringing and connects to the right one automatically.

feature_entries.title: Google Assistant and Alexa compatible
feature_entries.description: Just say “OK Google” or “Alexa” to activate your preferred voice assistant. Enjoy entertainment, connect with friends, get information, listen to music and notifications, set reminders, and more.

feature_entries.title: Find your headphones with Fast Pair
feature_entries.description: The WH-CH720N headphones support Google’s Fast Pair feature. Easily find your missing headphones by sound or check their last known location in Google’s Find My Device app on your smartphone.

feature_entries.title: Made with the environment in mind
feature_entries.description: The WH-CH720N headphones are designed for both comfort and environmental consciousness. The headphones use recycled plastic materials, and the packaging uses no plastic

JBL Vibe Buds 2 earbuds feature exciting JBL Pure Bass sound, plus Active Noise Cancelling and Smart Ambient technology so you decide how much of the outside world you want to hear. feature_entries.title: JBL Pure Bass sound
feature_entries.description: JBL Vibe Buds 2 earbuds feature 8mm dynamic drivers that deliver exciting JBL Pure Bass sound.

feature_entries.title: Active Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient
feature_entries.description: JBL Vibe Buds 2 earbuds come with Active Noise Cancelling to listen to your surroundings and filter out distracting noise. Smart Ambient lets you control how much of the outside world you want to hear, so you can talk with others or stay aware of your surroundings—all without taking your earbuds out.

feature_entries.title: 4 mics for crisp, clear calls
feature_entries.description: Two mics on each earbud pick up and clearly transmit your voice while canceling out ambient noise. So you can make clear, crisp calls even when you're walking through a busy park on a breezy day.

feature_entries.title: Water and dust resistant
feature_entries.description: Your JBL Vibe Buds 2 are IP54 water and dust resistant, so you can use them in rainy or windy conditions. Even the case is IPX2 resistant, so don't worry about bringing it along with you.

feature_entries.title: JBL Headphones app
feature_entries.description: Use the JBL Headphones app to select the EQ that fits your style—or customize your own. Voice Prompts in multiple languages give you useful information like whether your battery is running low. Or chill out and recharge in Relax Mode by choosing one of five peaceful sounds, like gentle ocean vibes or a crackling wood fire.

feature_entries.title: 40 total hours of playback time, plus speed charging
feature_entries.description: Enjoy 10 hours of playtime, plus another three full charges (30 hours) in the charging case.* Need to recharge even faster? 10 minutes on a USB type-C charging cable will give you another three hours of playtime. (*with ANC off)

feature_entries.title: Multi-point connection
feature_entries.description: Pair your JBL Vibe Buds 2 earbuds with two Bluetooth devices at the same time and then switch effortlessly from one to the other. So if you're watching a video on your tablet, you won't miss a call on your mobile phone.

feature_entries.title: Seamless Bluetooth pairing
feature_entries.description: JBL Vibe Buds 2 come enabled with both Fast Pair by Google and Swift Pair by Microsoft, so they immediately pair with both your Android devices and Microsoft computer with a single tap.

products.title: Samsung - Galaxy Buds3 FE Wireless Earbud Headphones - Gray
products.description: Built for elevated sound and call quality for your everyday, Galaxy Buds3 FE bring your music, videos and conversations to life- no matter where you are. Whether you’re tuning in or reaching out, everything sounds exactly as it should with improved background noise reduction for crisp calls and a more powerful ANC. You can also easily change songs, control the volume, answer calls or play and pause with improved touch controls that place everything at your fingertips. Access Gemini on your Galaxy phone for on-the-go AI assistance- just say the word. From setting reminders to searching the web or translating conversations in real-time with Live Translate, Galaxy Buds3 FE make using your phone’s features feel easier and smarter. The sleek, new blade design with a comfortable fit stays snug without pressure so you can move freely without missing a beat. And with long-lasting battery power, your Buds are ready when you are and charge fast when they need to. Add to that seamless connection with your Galaxy devices. Enjoy effortless pairing and switching between your Galaxy phone, tablet or PC. It all just works- automatically, intuitively and beautifully. Enjoy smarter audio every day with Galaxy Buds3 FE.

feature_entries.title: Outside noise? Not your problem.
feature_entries.description: Cut out unwanted noise with Galaxy Buds3 FE.² With Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), you can experience the sounds you love without annoying distractions, whether you're listening to music while strolling through a busy park or catching up on a podcast at a coffee shop. Or, if you prefer, stay aware of your surroundings with Ambient mode.

feature_entries.title: Your everyday sound, now more powerful
feature_entries.description: From playlists to podcasts, now hear it all in incredible detail with Galaxy Buds3 FE. Feel the impact of every beat thanks to the larger¹ 11mm speakers that deliver deep bass. With 360 spatial audio, Buds3 FE ensure that your sound surrounds you from every angle to bring out the best in whatever you're listening to.

feature_entries.title: Every call, loud and clear
feature_entries.description: Enjoy clear phone calls, even in loud environments, with an additional microphone at the tip of the blade that ensures clear voice pickup and enhanced¹ AI-based background noise reduction. From juggling work calls to catching up with loved ones, confidently hear and be heard with Buds3 FE.

feature_entries.title: Uninterrupted audio with a long-lasting battery
feature_entries.description: Whatever the day looks like, Galaxy Buds3 FE’s long-lasting battery keeps you powered up. Whether you are binging on your favorite playlist or powering through work calls, Buds3 FE are built to keep up. And, when you need a top-up, the charging case gets you ready for what’s next.

feature_entries.title: Designed to fit. Made to enjoy.
feature_entries.description: From your morning commute to your evening jog, listen to what you love throughout your day. Your Galaxy Buds3 FE stay securely and comfortably in place, thanks to the newly redesigned rounded ear tips that come in three different sizes. With the new control stem, pinch and swipe to play, pause, adjust volume and answer calls, if you choose to, while on the go.

feature_entries.title: Talk to Gemini, hands-free
feature_entries.description: Have your hands full? No problem. Access Gemini⁴ on your Galaxy phone hands-free with Galaxy Buds3 FE, using your voice.⁴ Whether you’re mid-commute or mid-workout, get help with texts, reminders, directions and more, all without reaching for your phone.⁵

feature_entries.title: Your personal translator, in real-time
feature_entries.description: Wish you could speak to anyone, even if you don’t know their language? Simply use Real-Time Interpreter⁶ with Galaxy AI⁷ on your phone and listen as live translations are delivered straight to your Galaxy Buds3 FE, crisp and clear. From neighborhood gatherings to that new specialty market in town, Buds3 FE make it easier to communicate with people from other cultures.

feature_entries.title: Hear live translations, hands-free
feature_entries.description: From coordinating travel plans with a local guide to a conference call with a new international client, break down language barriers with Live Translate⁶ with Galaxy AI⁷ on your Galaxy phone and listen to it hands-free on your Galaxy Buds3 FE. Using the Samsung Phone app, you can hear real-time translations of any conversation crisp and clear, through your Buds3 FE.

feature_entries.title: Move between your Galaxy devices. Your Buds follow.
feature_entries.description: No need to dig through menus or re-pair every time you change devices. Galaxy Buds3 FE pair by opening the cradle⁸ and know exactly when to follow you from phone to Tab to PC.⁹ So whatever you're listening to, the switch is smooth and the connection is constant.

feature_entries.title: See it big. Hear it better.
feature_entries.description: Galaxy S25 FE and Buds3 FE are a match made in content heaven. With a wider display¹⁰ and bold, balanced audio, your favorite shows, games and videos feel immersive from the first second. The expansive screen and powerful sound work together to turn screen time into an experience.

feature_entries.title: Control at your fingertips
feature_entries.description: Control your own listening experience with Intuitive Control¹¹ on Galaxy Buds3 FE. Tap into the convenience of pinch-and-swipe controls that work the way you need them to- pause, skip tracks, accept calls and more, directly on your Buds.

feature_entries.title: Splash resistant
feature_entries.description: Listen all you want- with Galaxy Buds3 FE, a splash won’t dampen your playlist. The improved design stands up to water splashes with an IP54 rating,¹² so you can enjoy your favorite audio throughout the day, rain or shine.

feature_entries.title: No Buds left behind
feature_entries.description: It’s easy to recover your missing Buds with Find My Earbuds.¹⁴ Track the last location your Buds connected to your phone and then see it on a map.¹³ Never lose an earbud again.

products.description: Level up your workouts with JLab's Epic Sport ANC 3 - our most advanced and best-sounding sport earbuds yet. Engineered with hybrid dual drivers and Hi-Res Audio with noise cancellation, these IP66 sweatproof earbuds deliver unparalleled sound tailored for athletes. Stay motivated through intense sessions with an incredible 68+ hour battery, ergonomic sport fit, built-in interval timer, and customizable sound via the JLab App. Unlock superior performance with best-in-class audio, durability and features in our most premium sport earbuds ever.

products.page_description: Level up your workouts with JLab's Epic Sport ANC 3 - our most advanced and best-sounding sport earbuds yet. Engineered with hybrid dual drivers and Hi-Res Audio with noise cancellation, these IP66 sweatproof earbuds deliver unparalleled sound tailored for athletes. Stay motivated through intense sessions with an incredible 68+ hour battery, ergonomic sport fit, built-in interval timer, and customizable sound via the JLab App. Unlock superior performance with best-in-class audio, durability and features in our most premium sport earbuds ever.

feature_entries.title: Hybrid Dual Drivers
feature_entries.description: The Epic Lab Edition boasts hybrid dual drivers – a dynamic driver for rich bass and low frequencies, and a Knowles balanced armature driver for exquisite high frequencies. This fusion of drivers results in unparalleled, well-balanced, and crystal-clear sound quality. Here’s how Knowles created a balanced armature driver tuned for higher frequencies.

feature_entries.title: Hi-Res Audio
feature_entries.description: Immerse yourself in the richness of Hi-Res Audio, delivered through LDAC (for Android). On iOS you’ll experience AAC, an advanced audio compression codec, ensuring that every note and detail of your music is reproduced with stunning clarity.

feature_entries.title: Hybrid ANC
feature_entries.description: Smart Active Noise Cancelation adjusts to the environment and continually learns how to best cancel noises, offering the best audio experience. Control how you hear outside noise with three noise control modes: ANC On, ANC Off and Be Aware (pass through outside noises).

feature_entries.title: JLab App
feature_entries.description: With the new JLab App, you’ll have control to customize the Be Aware setting to let outside noise in, touch controls, and sound to your personal preference – or use the presets for JLab Signature, Balance or Bass Boost. Safe hearing option allows you to protect your ears from hearing damage with volume limits. Plus get software updates for your product right when they’re available. Available on the App or Google Play Store.

feature_entries.title: Sweatproof Sport Fit
feature_entries.description: Built to endure rigorous workouts, the IP66 rating protects against sweat and dirt, making these earbuds perfect for the gym, trails, and beyond. The ergonomic earhook is designed to fit even the smallest ears, staying securely and comfortably in place throughout your workout. Plus, with a built-in interval timer, you can easily program custom routines and stay focused on your training.

feature_entries.title: Serious Playtime
feature_entries.description: Epic Sport ANC 3 features 12+ hours of wireless playtime in each earbud and 56+ additional hours from the charging case. That’s 68+ total hours of Bluetooth playtime!

feature_entries.title: Connect to Multiple Devices
feature_entries.description: With Bluetooth Multipoint you enjoy the versatility of transitioning seamlessly from device to device. Hop from podcast on your computer to a call on your mobile. You can connect simultaneously to two devices – mobile, laptop and/or computer.

feature_entries.title: Clear Calls
feature_entries.description: Whether you're in a busy office or a noisy city street, the Flex Open Earbuds noise-canceling mic ensures crystal clear calls. The MEMS mic in each bud helps eliminate background noise, ensuring that your voice is heard loud and clear on the other end.

feature_entries.title: Lab Spatial Audio
feature_entries.description: Featuring spatial audio EQ straight from the Lab, enjoy another dimension and immersive sound. JLab’s spatial audio algorithm makes you feel like you’re sitting in the middle of a concert or standing in the middle of a fight scene.

feature_entries.title: Google Fast Pair
feature_entries.description: Enjoy even more effortless pairing with an Android device with Google Fast Pair. When you take out your earbuds and have a supported Android device, you’ll see a pop-up enabling you to connect via Bluetooth. Don’t worry if you’re not an Android user, JLab earbuds will connect with any Bluetooth enabled device like iPhone with just a couple taps.

feature_entries.title: Dual Charging
feature_entries.description: After you run through the impressive up to 56+ hours of playtime, the Epic Lab Edition offers dual charging options, enabling you to power up wirelessly or through a USB-C cable, providing versatility and convenience.

products.page_description: Step into the future of listening with MOMENTUM True Wireless 4. These remarkable headphones bring features to revolutionize how we share and stream audio. Experience music as intended by artists, thanks to Sennheiser’s TrueResponse transducer system, ensuring every detail is heard and felt. Lossless audio guarantees uncompromised sound transmission, delivering bit-by-bit quality audio to your ears. Tailor your audio experience to fit your hearing using Sound Personalization, designed in collaboration with the Fraunhofer Institute in Germany. The 5-band equalizer and pre-set sound modes let you fine-tune your preferences. Stay at the forefront of technology with advanced wireless features like Bluetooth 5.4 compatibility and Auracast support. The customizable touch interface offers seamless control, while Qi charging keeps your earbuds powered on the go. Enjoy exceptional comfort during all-day wear with ergonomic design and softer ear tips. Enjoy up to 30 hours of listening pleasure, with a quick charge providing an hour of playtime in just 8 minutes. Advanced adaptive ANC ensures immersive sound, while Transparency Mode ensures you stay aware of your surroundings. The high-quality 6-mic system enhances calls and voice assistant interactions. Discover the perfect blend of modern features, timeless design, and Sennheiser quality, available in multiple premium finishes.

products.page_description: Experience the future of sleep - Ozlo Sleepbuds, the science-backed earbuds engineered to block out snoring, city sounds, and other nighttime disruptions. Designed with advanced noise-masking technology and streaming audio, Sleepbuds help you fall asleep faster, stay asleep longer, and wake restored. Unlike traditional headphones, Ozlo Sleepbuds are tiny, lightweight, and built for all-night comfort — even for side sleepers. They adapt to your environment, mask unwanted noise with soothing sounds, and can stream your favorite sleep playlists, podcasts, or meditations through Bluetooth LE. Once you drift off, built-in biometric sensing detects when you’re asleep and automatically switches from streaming to gentle masking sounds — so you wake up refreshed, not tangled in noise. Backed by science, designed for comfort, and powered by personalization through the Ozlo App, these Sleepbuds make every night a restorative one.

products.page_description: Redefine your possible with Shokz OpenRun Mini bone conduction headphones, formerly known as Aeropex, designed for endurance athletes. OpenRun Mini features a comfortable 0.83-inch smaller band than the standard size with all the same innovative features, making it ideal for smaller head sizes and those who prefer a more snug fit. For the past 10 years, Shokz has been dedicated to providing safety and situational awareness through bone conduction technology. Unlike traditional in-ear headphones, OpenRun features the signature Shokz open-ear design to keep you tuned in to your music and your moments. The enhanced audio features ensure clear sound, powerful volume, and a rich bass while you’re listening. OpenRun are both lightweight and durable for comfortable all-day use that can also withstand the elements. The IP67 waterproof rating makes OpenRun perfect for sweaty and rainy workouts, although they are not designed for underwater swimming. Embrace a new challenge powered by Shokz.

feature_entries.title: Open-ear design
feature_entries.description: The Shokz signature open-ear design is powered by patented bone conduction technology. The design allows you to stay open to your surroundings while listening to your audio favorites for environmental safety and awareness.

feature_entries.title: PremiumPitch 2.0+
feature_entries.description: Get the most out of your audio experience with clear sound, powerful volume, and a rich bass. OpenRun brings the next generation of sound preservation technology to your active lifestyle.

feature_entries.title: Comfortable and secure fit
feature_entries.description: OpenRun Mini's titanium wraparound band ensures a comfortable fit, and keeps your headphone securely in place — no matter how intense your workout.

feature_entries.title: Lightweight
feature_entries.description: At only 26g, the OpenRun headphones are extremely lightweight, making them perfect for all-day wear.

feature_entries.title: IP67 waterproof rating
feature_entries.description: OpenRun Mini headphones are designed to weather even the harshest workout conditions. The IP67 rating means they’re dirt-proof, sweat-resistant, and will withstand submersion in 1 meter of water for up to 30 minutes. OpenRun are not intended for swimming.

feature_entries.title: 8 hours of music + calls
feature_entries.description: Outlast the competition with up to 8 hours of battery life after a full charge and up to 240 hours on standby mode. OpenRun Mini were designed for long training sessions as well as going from your workout to work day seamlessly.

feature_entries.title: Quick charge
feature_entries.description: Feel like a short run? A 10-minute quick charge gives you 1.5 hours of listening time so you can get on-the-go when the motivation hits.

feature_entries.title: Dual noise-canceling mic
feature_entries.description: Answer calls on-the-go with the precisely placed dual noise-canceling microphones. They exclude surrounding noise, effectively enhancing speech for crystal-clear calls and simple hands-free chatting via a compatible device.

feature_entries.title: Bluetooth v5.1
feature_entries.description: Pair open-ear listening with your favorite music streaming devices for easy wireless listening. OpenRun Mini's updated Bluetooth capabilities support HFP, HSP, A2DP and AVRCP Bluetooth profiles.

feature_entries.title: Moisture detection alert
feature_entries.description: To keep your OpenRun Mini in top shape, your device will alert you if the headphones are plugged into the charger while wet. Follow the prompt to remove the headphones from the charger for optimal battery life.

products.title: Beats - Fit Pro True Wireless Noise Cancelling In-Ear Earbuds - Sage Gray
products.description: True wireless noise cancelling Beats Fit Pro with comfortable, secure-fit wingtips are engineered for all-day activity. The flexible wingtip design conforms to your ear to comfortably lock in place so you can experience powerful, balanced sound during your work day or your workouts. With two distinct listening modes, you are in control of what you hear. Fully adaptive Active Noise Cancelling (ANC) uses real-time audio calibration to continuously pinpoint external sounds and optimize sound output, and when you need to be aware of your surroundings, easily switch to Transparency mode. Beats Fit Pro supports Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking for immersive music, movies, and games.¹ These earbuds are powered by the Apple H1 chip. The result — instant one-touch pairing², Automatic Switching³, Audio Sharing⁵, and hands-free “Hey Siri”⁴ for Apple devices. For Android users, easily connect via Class 1 Bluetooth right out of the box. With the Beats app for Android¹¹, you’ll get enhanced features like one-touch pairing, customized controls, battery levels, firmware updates, and a Fit Test to help you get the best sound and fit out of your earbuds. Each earbud has up to 6 hours of listening time⁶ with 18 additional hours⁷ provided by its matching, pocket-sized charging case to give you up to 24 hours of combined playback.

feature_entries.title: Surrounds You in Sound
feature_entries.description: Beats Fit Pro is engineered to deliver powerful, balanced sound via a custom acoustic platform that stays with you through your daily activities.
A proprietary, dual-element diaphragm driver resides within a twochamber housing inside the Bluetooth earbuds, resulting in clear sound with outstanding stereo separation.
An advanced digital processor then optimizes audio performance for loudness and clarity, while simultaneously ensuring clean noise-cancellation.

Beats Fit Pro supports Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking for immersive music, movies, and games.¹ Dynamic head tracking uses gyroscopes and accelerometers to adjust the sound as you turn your head, for a multi-dimensional experience that makes you feel like you’re inside of it.

feature_entries.title: Equipped with Apple H1
feature_entries.description: Powered by the same Apple H1 headphone chip in AirPods Pro, Beats Fit Pro are noise cancelling Bluetooth earbuds that help you tackle your day.
Enjoy instant one-touch pairing², Automatic Switching³, and hands-free “Hey Siri”⁴ on your iPhone or other Apple devices.
Audio Sharing⁵ with Apple AirPods, Apple AirPods Pro, or another pair of Beats Earbuds means you can easily share your favorite music with all of your friends.

feature_entries.title: Power Your Day
feature_entries.description: The earbuds have up to 6 hours of listening time⁶ with 18 additional hours⁷ provided by its pocket-sized charging case. That means that Beats Fit Pro gives you up to 24 hours of combined playback.

With Active Noise Cancelling or Transparency mode turned off, you’ll get up to 7 hours of listening time. If you need a little extra juice, 5-minute Fast Fuel charging gives up to 1 hour of playback⁸ when battery is low.

feature_entries.title: Hear What Matters
feature_entries.description: With two distinct listening modes, you are in control of what you hear. These fully adaptive Active Noise Cancelling (ANC) earbuds use real-time audio calibration to continuously pinpoint external sounds and optimize sound output.

When you need to be aware of your surroundings, turn on Transparency mode. The Bluetooth Earbuds with dual beamforming microphones capture environmental and ambient sound around you to mix in with your music.
Now, you can always choose the listening mode that fits your needs.

feature_entries.title: Beats app for Android
feature_entries.description: Enables features like one-touch pairing, customized controls, and a Fit Test ¹⁰

feature_entries.title: Sweat and water resistant
feature_entries.description: Beats Fit Pro offers an IPX4 rating for sweat and water resistance.⁹

feature_entries.title: Class 1 Bluetooth
feature_entries.description: For extended range and fewer dropouts.

feature_entries.title: Loud and Clear
feature_entries.description: With a built-in accelerometer and Class 1 Bluetooth technology, Beats Fit Pro can detect when you’re speaking to help you sound your best.
Dual beamforming microphones pinpoint your voice while a digital processor cuts out external noise and wind, so your voice is clear and easy to hear.
¹Compatible hardware and software required. Works with compatible content in supported apps. Not all content available in Dolby Atmos. Head tracking feature requires iPhone or iPad.
²Requires iOS 15.1 or later
³Automatic Switching requires macOS 11.1, iOS 14.3, iPadOS 14.3, watchOS 7.2, or tvOS 14.3 or later.
⁴Siri may not be available in all languages or in all areas, and features may vary by area. Internet access is required. Cellular data charges may apply.

⁵Audio Sharing is compatible with Beats Fit Pro, Beats Flex, Solo Pro, Powerbeats Pro, Powerbeats, Solo3 Wireless, Powerbeats3 Wireless, Beats Studio3 Wireless, BeatsX, AirPods (1st generation or later), AirPods Pro, and AirPods Max.

Works with iPhone 8 or later and iPod touch (7th generation) with the latest version of iOS; and 12.9-inch iPad Pro (2nd generation or later), 11-inch iPad Pro, 10.5-inch iPad Pro, iPad (5th generation or later),
iPad Air (3rd generation), and iPad mini (5th generation) with the latest version of iPadOS.

⁶Testing conducted by Apple in September 2021 using preproduction Beats Fit Pro and Charging Case units and software paired with iPhone 12 units and prerelease software. The playlist consisted of 358 unique audio tracks purchased from the iTunes Store (256-Kbps AAC encoding).

products.title: JBL - Endurance Peak 3 Dust and Waterproof True Wireless Active Earbuds - 2023 - White
products.description: Built to endure your personal bests. Your lifestyle is active—you need wireless earbuds that can keep up. The Endurance Peak 3 is the perfect training partner, pumping your motivational playlists to you with up to 50 hours of playback and rich JBL pure bass sound you can feel in your muscles. The durable IP68 dust and water proof design can handle the dustiest mountain trail and the sweatiest gym session, while the bendable Powerhook together with the TwistLock ear hook enhancer ensures a secure, comfortable fit that stays in no matter how you move your body. And with the ability to make crystal clear calls from anywhere and stay aware of your surroundings, you'll stay connected to the world no matter where your workout takes you.

feature_entries.title: JBL pure bass sound

feature_entries.title: Open-Ear Comfort
feature_entries.description: Featuring Shokz's open-ear design, the OpenRun Pro 2 keeps you aware of your surroundings while you work out, helping to improve safety and enhancing your listening experience. It optimizes volume range for clear audio even when you're on the go.

feature_entries.title: Leak-Free Audio
feature_entries.description: The bone conduction unit features an integrated design, encasing all components within a protective metal compartment helping to minimize sound leakage. feature_entries.title: Secure Fit
feature_entries.description: Engineered for the extremes, OpenRun Pro 2's ergonomic ear hooks and unibody frame provide a secure, comfortable fit that defies slips and adjustments. feature_entries.title: Cloud-Comfort Fit

feature_entries.title: IP55 Water-Resistant
feature_entries.description: Rain, sweat, splashes – bring it on. An IP55 water-resistant design, including a double-layer mesh structure and nano-hydrophobic coating, ensures durability against the elements.

feature_entries.title: AI Noise Reduction Algorithm for Crystal-Clear Call Quality

feature_entries.title: Wind-Resistant Microphone

feature_entries.title: Your phone does the translating, and your Buds do the audio with Galaxy AI
feature_entries.description: From phoning a relative back home to calling in reservations while traveling abroad, break down language barriers with Galaxy AI. Using the Samsung Phone app, you can hear real-time translations of your conversation in stunning clarity through your Buds.¹

feature_entries.title: Hear translations through your Buds with Galaxy AI
feature_entries.description: Wish you could speak like a local, no matter where you go? Now it’s easy to communicate freely with someone in another language. Simply use the interpreter feature on your Galaxy AI phone to hear crystal-clear real-time translations through your Galaxy Buds during face-to-face conversations.¹

feature_entries.title: Every moment now sounds epic
feature_entries.description: Studio-quality sound isn’t just for the pros. Feel every note like you’re there with Galaxy Buds2 Pro.²Now everyone can have a next-level listening experience, whether you’re rocking out to your playlist or staying informed with a podcast

feature_entries.title: Hear only what you want
feature_entries.description: Reduce unwanted noise with Galaxy Buds2 Pro. They use Intelligent Active Noise Cancellation to quiet even the loudest outside sounds. Tune in to what matters most without being bothered by distracting sounds around you³

feature_entries.title: Sound never felt so right
feature_entries.description: Pop ‘em in and forget they’re there. Galaxy Buds2 Pro are designed to be even more comfortable than before and fit securely no matter what you’re doing. Whether you’re working or working out, make all your moves comfortably.

feature_entries.title: Surround sound that’s all about you
feature_entries.description: Go beyond just listening and surround yourself with the sounds you love — and nothing else. Amplify what you like.² Minimize what you don’t. Enhanced 360-degree audio brings out the tones you love from every angle for a personalized surround-sound experience every time you pop them in

feature_entries.title: Record like a pro
feature_entries.description: Capture sound like a pro — without dragging around the bulky recording equipment — with 360 Audio Recording.4 Content creators, take note. Create captivating videos anywhere with high-quality audio that brings out the best in your voice and other sounds.

Whether you’re recording a meeting at the office or shooting content on the street, Galaxy Buds2 Pro makes it a breeze to record excellent audio. Simply pop 'em in and start the action. They’ll pick up important sound details for cleaner and clearer audio, from your voice to your music to whatever you happen to be filming.

feature_entries.title: Not today, water
feature_entries.description: Water won’t ruin your workout. Your IPX7 water-resistant Galaxy Buds2 Pro can keep the beat going even with a little rain. They’re protected for immersion up to 3 feet deep for a half-hour⁵

feature_entries.title: Listen to what you love, and then some
feature_entries.description: From your favorite podcast to a late-night chat with a friend to an online video-game session, the long-lasting battery6 means you can lose yourself for hours without having to stop to plug in. Then, when you run out of battery, get a boost in a snap with fast charging — up to an hour of playtime on a five-minute in-case charge.
Need a power boost, but left your charger at home? Simply place your Galaxy Buds2 Pro on your Galaxy smartphone⁷ for a fast, cord-free charge on the go

feature_entries.title: A Galaxy in perfect sync
feature_entries.description: These Buds play well with others. Galaxy Buds2 Pro pair easily with your Galaxy devices. Simply open the case and tap connect to pair with your Galaxy devices quickly. ⁸ Whether you’re pairing with your tablet, phone or Watch, Buds2 Pro syncs in a cinch and automatically switches audio sources when an alert or call comes in to keep you in the know

products.title: Bose - QuietComfort Wireless Noise Cancelling Over-the-Ear Bluetooth Headphones - Twilight Blue
products.description: Take charge of your music with Bose QuietComfort Bluetooth headphones. These noise cancelling headphones come equipped with Quiet and Aware Modes that let you toggle between full noise cancelling or full awareness of your surroundings. Or create a custom mode on these Bluetooth headphones to adjust noise cancellation and add Wind Block to tune out breezy environments. Just press play on these over ear headphones for high-fidelity sound that’s also customizable with adjustable EQ. Use the Bose app to crank the bass, tweak the treble, and personalize your experience. Plus, these headphones with built in microphone are crafted with all-day wear and multi-taskers in mind. Available in striking colors, the premium materials and bold, iconic design combine comfort and style. On-ear toggles make switching from music to calls easy and the powerful battery means it’s ready for the long haul. Enjoy up to 24 hours of play time on a single charge with the Bose QC wireless headphones and up to 2.5 hours of play time with a quick 15-minute boost.
