products.title: Sony - WF-1000XM5 True Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds - Black
products.description: The WF-1000XM5 features cutting-edge technology to deliver premium sound quality and the *best truly wireless Noise Cancelling performance on the market. With a specially designed driver unit, for wide frequency production, deep bass and clear vocals, these headphones are designed to immerse you in a sound so good, it feels like you’re in the studio with your favorite artists.

source_listing.title: Sony - WF-1000XM5 True Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds - Black

products.page_description: The WF-1000XM5 features cutting-edge technology to deliver premium sound quality and the *best truly wireless Noise Cancelling performance on the market. With a specially designed driver unit, for wide frequency production, deep bass and clear vocals, these headphones are designed to immerse you in a sound so good, it feels like you’re in the studio with your favorite artists.

feature_entries.title: Noise Cancellation
feature_entries.description: The WF-1000XM5 reduces external noise over a wide bandwidth, from low to high frequencies. Real-time noise cancelling processing can be optimized to provide the best performance for your environment so you will hear a big difference, especially in airplanes or trains.¹

feature_entries.title: Astonishing sound quality
feature_entries.description: Enjoy richer, more detailed vocals thanks to a specially designed driver unit Dynamic Driver X for wide frequency reproduction, you will experience richer vocals and enhanced fine details.

feature_entries.title: Excellent call quality
feature_entries.description: Mute the outside world with Precise Voice Pickup Technology and advanced audio signal processing. The person on the other end of the call will hear your voice clearly, even when you are in noisy situations.

feature_entries.title: Small and beautifully designed
feature_entries.description: With an improved glossy texture and a more luxurious feel, these earbuds fit comfortably in your ears while keeping out external sounds.

feature_entries.title: Noise Cancellation technology
feature_entries.description: Exclusively developed by Sony, the Integrated Processor V2 unlocks the full potential of our HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN2e. The unique combination of technology controls the six microphones, across both ears, to deliver unprecedented noise cancelling quality.

feature_entries.title: Multipoint Connection
feature_entries.description: For smooth switching, the WF-1000XM5 can be paired with two Bluetooth devices simultaneously so, when a call comes in, your headphones can automatically connect to the right one.

feature_entries.title: Adjusts to the world around you
feature_entries.description: Adaptive Sound Control senses where you are and what you’re doing, then uses AI to change ambient sound settings for the ideal listening experience. Over time, it will learn your behavior, recognize locations you visit, and tailor the sound to suit your location.

feature_entries.title: Talk and only hear ambient sound
feature_entries.description: You can set Speak-to-Chat to pause the music as soon as you start speaking to someone, so you can hear just ambient sound and conduct a conversation – handy if you want to keep your headphones on or your hands are full.

feature_entries.title: Water resistant for everyday use
feature_entries.description: With an IPX4 resistance rating, splashes and sweat won’t stop these headphones – so you can keep moving to the music.

feature_entries.title: Designed with the environment in mind.
feature_entries.description: With Sony’s commitment to achieve a smaller footprint and help you enjoy the music you love, plastics are not used in the WF-1000XM5 packaging material (except for excluding coating and adhesives).

feature_entries.title: Listen all day, charge in minutes
feature_entries.description: You can enjoy up to 8 hours of charge on your headphones and store another up to 16 hours in the case for a total of up to 24 hours of listening every time you leave the house. And for your convenience, 3-minute quick charge will give you up to 60 minutes of play.

feature_entries.title: Designed for less distortion
feature_entries.description: Thanks to two new processors, the HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN2e and Integrated Processor V2, the WF-1000XM5 incorporates precision 24-bit audio processing and high- performance analogue amplification. The result is low distortion and crystal clear audio.

feature_entries.title: AI technology for precision sound
feature_entries.description: Using Edge-AI, DSEE Extreme upscales compressed digital music files in real-time, including those from popular streaming services.

feature_entries.title: Spatial sound with 360 Reality Audio
feature_entries.description: With 360 Reality Audio headphones and the Sony Headphones Connect app, an advanced personal optimization algorithm gives you an even greater sense of sound space, distance and height, allowing you to become even more immersed in the music.

feature_entries.title: Comfortable and secure
feature_entries.description: Our WF-1000XM5 earbuds feature a shape with an ergonomic design for a more stable fit. We’ve designed the WF-1000XM5 utilizing extensive ear-shape data collated since introducing the world’s first in-ear headphones in 1982.

feature_entries.title: A clear, stable Bluetooth signal
feature_entries.description: These earbuds utilize a powerful new Integrated Processor 2, which transmits a Bluetooth signal simultaneously to and from both ears, so you can enjoy a stable sound.

feature_entries.title: Always hear and be heard
feature_entries.description: A wind noise reduction structure and a mesh wrap in the microphone will minimize noise during calls so you can be heard clearly in windy conditions.

feature_entries.title: Feel a more stable fitting earbud
feature_entries.description: Noise Isolation Earbud Tips feature a unique polyurethane foam material which reduces noise in the high-frequency range. Soft and elastic, they maximize the contact area between the earbud tip and the ear canal, insulating your sound and reducing noise.

feature_entries.title: Find your headphones with Fast Pair
feature_entries.description: In one tap, the WF-1000XM5 enables quick, effortless Bluetooth pairing with your Android devices - you can even check to see where you last placed it.

¹As of April 20, 2023. Ambient noise reduction according to research by Sony Corporation, measured using JEITA-compliant guidelines for the top 10 brands (by market share) of truly wireless style of Noise Cancelling headphones market.

products.title: BlueParrott - B650-XT Wireless Bluetooth Mono Headset with 96% Noise-Cancelling Microphone and Active Noise Cancellation - Black
products.description: The BlueParrott B650-XT Bluetooth headset for cell phone provides incredibly clear calls in high-noise environments making it the perfect solution for truck drivers, delivery drivers, farmers, landscapers, and RV drivers who need reliable communication on the go. Equipped with 96% noise cancellation for the microphone and Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) for the earcup, our wireless headset for work effectively eliminates unwanted noise during calls. Whether you're driving long hauls, making deliveries, working the farm, or cruising in your RV, our wireless headset offers up to 36 hours of talk time on a single charge, so you can stay connected all day - from the road to the job site, to winding down with music or a movie, and still have power left for tomorrow. With an impressive 300-foot (100-meter) wireless range, you can leave your phone in the vehicle and still have full access to your calls, making it perfect for long-distance drivers and those who are always on the move. Its IP54-rated protection against dust and water ensures that the B650-XT can handle the rugged demands of trucking, deliveries, landscaping, farming, or RV living. Our noise cancelling headset for delivery drivers allows you to mute calls, speed dial a preferred contact, or Push-to-Talk with your coworkers using the customizable BlueParrott Button. Simply program it with your most-used function for instant access without taking your eyes off the road. In addition, the hear-through headphone lets you use your voice to control calls, GPS directions, music, voice assistants, and more. Our trucker Bluetooth headset pairs up to 7 devices and connects with 2 devices simultaneously, and provides 600 hours of standby time.

products.title: Sennheiser - HD 660S2 Wired Over-the-Ear Headphones - Black
products.description: Despite the HD 660S’s standing as one of the world’s popular audiophile headphones, some customers nevertheless wanted one very specific enhancement: even deeper bass. Because whether it’s a thunderous crescendo of timpani or the pulsating beat of electronic dance music, there is nothing like accurate, powerful sub bass to infuse your listening with drama. Audiophiles—and anyone looking for comfortable, non-fatiguing, high-end headphones—can now get even more impact and emotion from the HD 660S2. The headphone’s warm, relaxed tone is reflected by their timeless styling with elegant bronze accents. With its open-back design and outstanding comfort, the HD 660S2 is also destined to be a favorite for long listening sessions. This version builds on all the strengths of its formidable predecessor. The same world-class precision and resolution still let you pick out individual instruments like with no other headphone. Or experience the joy of discovering sonic details in recordings you’ve known for years—now underscored with more and deeper low end. Indeed, the standard-setter for extended listening has now become the standard-setter for extended bass as well. Enhancing this heralded audio design without detracting from its many strengths was, however, a daunting task. So, our engineers set out to systematically identify and exploit every opportunity in their quest to improve on the acclaimed HD 660S design. We adjusted the compliance of the surround, for instance, dropping the resonance frequency to 70 Hz. Considerable effort went into optimizing the airflow around the transducer. The coil in the HD 660S2 has also been revised to match the legendary HD 600 & 650, resulting in an impedance of 300 ohms. The coil offers a high magnetic force and electrical damping for a clean impulse response. It also increases sensitivity over the entire frequency spectrum by using the magnet’s air gap more efficiently. Taken together, these efforts and more have paid off in spades. Sound pressure at the lowest octaves has doubled. Now, you can feel the music more than ever before—with all the depth and weight that ultra-low frequencies invoke. The lowest A on the piano (27.5 Hz) or the pounding root note of a bass drum (45-60 Hz) are just as big, expansive, and imposing as if they were live. The unique combination of impactful bass combined with the warm tuning and smooth treble will be a revelation for audiophile listeners. It’s an even better way to lose yourself in comfortable, non-fatiguing, high-end sound—while feeling its full low-end power.

products.page_description: True icons never die; they just get better with time. Major V is no different. From its explosive Marshall signature sound to its everlasting design, every detail of these headphones has been painstakingly considered and refined. Featuring 100+ hours of wireless playtime combined with a rugged and foldable design, Major V is best paired with your next great adventure. With an array of new and updated features, Major V are headphones you can count on and that make the moment count. The M-button gives you direct access to Spotify Tap or you can reconfigure it using the Marshall app to access EQ presets or voice assistant instead. How you use it is up to you. The built-in mic has also been upgraded to reduce wind noise and create better call quality. Taking calls on the road is now smoother than ever. In between the 100+ hours of playtime, Major V’s wireless charging capabilities mean you’ll be back up and running in no time. Help your headphones last even longer by switching on our battery preservation feature which sets a charging limit, ensuring you get the most out of the battery life. Yes, our Major V headphones keep delivering hit after hit.

feature_entries.title: Marshall Signature Sound
feature_entries.description: Thunderous bass, smooth mids and crisp treble. Major V delivers the Marshall signature sound you know and love. We also reduced distortion so that you can hear your music in absolute clarity. With Major V, the sound speaks for itself.

feature_entries.title: 100+ Hours Of Wireless Playtime
feature_entries.description: Your next adventure awaits, and Major V is in for the ride. Packing 100+ hours of wireless playtime, you can be gone for days. When you do run out of power, your journey won’t be held up for long, as Major V can be charged using the quick charge option.

feature_entries.title: Rugged And Foldable Design
feature_entries.description: It doesn’t get more classic than our Major V headphones. Their ruggedness means it’ll take a lot to wear them down, while their foldable design makes them easy to pack away and carry with you wherever you go. Every iteration keeps improving, but the design remains timeless.

feature_entries.title: Customisable M-button
feature_entries.description: Instantly access your favourite features thanks to Major V’s M-button and the Marshall Bluetooth app. All you have to do is press on the M-script logo to open the Spotify Tap default function, your EQ settings or voice assistant.

feature_entries.title: Wireless Charging
feature_entries.description: We don’t like wires either, they just get in the way. Thanks to wireless charging, it’s simple to give Major V a boost when needed. Just rest your headphones on a charging pad and you’re good to go. If you like keeping it old school, you’ll receive a USB-C charging cable in the box too.

feature_entries.title: Bluetooth Le Audio-Ready
feature_entries.description: We don’t want anything to get in the way of your music so Major V is geared up for a Bluetooth LE Audio future. This future-proof technology will deliver higher audio quality, while increasing streaming range and improving audio sync, for an even better connection when watching video.

products.page_description: The dynamic sound, all-day comfort, and rugged design of JBL Endurance Zone earbuds will inspire you to reach for your physical limits and beyond. JBL OpenSound technology fuels your workout with punchy sound from a perfect listening angle that keeps your ears free, but aware of the surroundings. And there's minimal sound leakage—because the person on the next yoga mat over doesn't need to hear what you're listening to. The comfortable, lightweight design keeps you going for hours, while the secure ergonomic earhook curve and rainproof, dustproof, and sweatproof design lets you exercise as long and as hard as you like, in even the wettest weather. Stay motivated with up to 32 hours of combined battery life. These earbuds are serious workout gear, designed for your hardest workouts.

feature_entries.title: JBL OpenSound technology
feature_entries.description: Enjoy clear, exciting music buds-free, so you can always hear your surroundings while you exercise. A sensitive 18x11mm dynamic driver delivers crisp, clear highs and round, rich mids, while our adaptive bass boost algorithm provides the beat that keeps you moving. The precise fit and directional sound of your JBL Endurance Zone earbuds ensures minimal sound leakage. So even if you have to take a call at the gym, your conversations will always remain private.

feature_entries.title: Designed for sports
feature_entries.description: Get a secure, stable fit every time with a high-grade liquid silicone earhook and adaptable memory wire. Even if you wear your earbuds all day long, they'll fit perfectly, no matter how active you get.

feature_entries.title: IP68 water and dust proof
feature_entries.description: Sweat, rain, salt water, and sand? Sounds like a great time. JBL Endurance Zone earbuds carry an IP68 waterproof and dustproof rating, so they can withstand it all. Not to mention high temperatures, high humidity, or long-distance drops.

feature_entries.title: High durability for intensive use
feature_entries.description: Both the earbuds and the charging case are made from a rugged, scratch-resistant material. They're also easy to grip, even after a sweaty workout, so they won't go flying when you take them out. And no matter how many times you adjust them, the rugged earhook resists stretching and twisting, so they'll always fit like new.

feature_entries.title: 4 mics for crisp, clear calls
feature_entries.description: Two beamforming mics per earbud effectively capture your voice while suppressing noise from other sources. Meanwhile, the beamforming algorithm minimizes unwanted ambient noise, making your authentic voice more intelligible. The hydrodynamic windproof design significantly reduces distortion from air friction and gives you a crystal-clear call experience—even in the middle of an outdoor run on a breezy day.

feature_entries.title: Up to 32 hours of playtime, plus speed charge
feature_entries.description: Your JBL Endurance Zone earbuds have enough power to run a marathon. With up to 8 hours in the earbuds and another 24 in the carrying case, you can make it through a week's worth of training runs or gym classes before you need to recharge. Need a quick top-up? 10 minutes of charging via the USB-C cable* will give you another 3 hours.

feature_entries.title: Convenient to carry
feature_entries.description: Keep your earbuds close at hand. The rugged, durable charging case has a lanyard hole so you can keep them within reach in or on your bag.

feature_entries.title: Customize your experience with the JBL Headphones app
feature_entries.description: Find your own sound using the 10-band EQ. Or change the intuitive touch controls on each earbud to handle your music and calls just the way you like.

feature_entries.title: Google Fast Pair
feature_entries.description: It just takes one click to pair your JBL Endurance Zone earbuds with your Android Bluetooth® device. After that, Google Fast Pair takes care of it for you.

feature_entries.title: Google Finder
feature_entries.description: If one of your earbuds ever does pop out while you're on the trail (or if you forget which bag you put them in), don't worry. You can locate them quickly with Google Finder, which uses any other nearby Bluetooth® LE devices to help pinpoint just where they are. One or both buds will emit a high-frequency sound when they're in range.

feature_entries.title: Google Audio Switch
feature_entries.description: Seamlessly switch from one Android Bluetooth® device to another. Jump from a video on your tablet to a call on your mobile phone, and never miss a moment.

feature_entries.title: Multi-point connection
feature_entries.description: Pair your JBL Endurance Zone earbuds with up to two Bluetooth® devices at the same time and then switch effortlessly from one to another. So if you're in the middle of an exercise video on your tablet, you won't miss a call from your partner on your mobile phone.

products.title: Garmin - dezl 210 Bluetooth Premium 2-in-1 Headset - Black
products.description: Hear the call, see the way. The premium two-in-one dēzl Headset 210 sheds new light on the longhaul audio experience. It combines outstanding noise-canceling technology with ultralong battery life, quick conversion to full stereo headphones when off duty and a useful built-in LED flashlight for hands-free illumination in and out of your truck cab. The flashlight, mounted on the mic boom, easily cycles through red, white and extra-bright white LEDs to provide the lighting intensity you need. Plus, the headset’s superior battery life supports up to 60 hours of continuous talk time with bluetooth technology. Active noise cancellation in the ear cups provides crystal-clear audio with enhanced bass performance while noise cancellation in the adjustable boom mic distinguishes your voice from background noise, so you can be heard clearly on calls. Seamless integration with a dēzl OTR truck navigator (sold separately) lets navigation prompts blend into your headset audio stream while your eyes remain on the road and your hands stay on the wheel.

feature_entries.title: Two-in-one design
feature_entries.description: The headset’s quick-release ear cup design makes it easy to switch from single-ear for driving to fully immersive stereo headphones for entertainment during breaks. No tools or extra hardware are needed to change configurations.

feature_entries.title: Audio with ANC
feature_entries.description: Engineered for noise-canceling audio excellence in loud road noise environments, this purpose-built trucking headset features ANC with enhanced bass performance. The ear cup and adjustable boom mic work to block out interference and deliver crystal-clear audio.

feature_entries.title: Built-in flashlight
feature_entries.description: The useful built-in flashlight, mounted on the mic boom, easily cycles through red, white and extra-bright white LEDs for hands-free illumination inside and outside your truck cab. Additionally, the flashlight provides helpful illumination when you are outside the truck in dark or poorly lit areas.

feature_entries.title: Long-haul talk power
feature_entries.description: Ultralong battery life supports up to 60 hours of continuous bluetooth talk time between charges. So, you can stay in touch for the long haul.

feature_entries.title: Designed for drivers
feature_entries.description: The ergonomic design is purpose-built for durability with corrosion-resistant stainless steel construction. Plush memory foam-padded ear cushion with synthetic leather provide all-day comfort, while the modern contour allows for more flexibility against your head or headwear.

feature_entries.title: Hnads-free calling
feature_entries.description: Built-in bluetooth wireless technology lets you pair your headset with your compatible smartphone, so you can make and receive calls without taking your hands off the wheel.

feature_entries.title: Connect multiple devices
feature_entries.description: Bring more convenience behind the wheel when you wirelessly connect up to two devices with bluetooth to the headset at once. For example, stream media from one device with the ability to easily switch to accept an incoming call from your paired smartphone — all while your eyes remain on the road.

feature_entries.title: Stow and go
feature_entries.description: This premium headset comes with a convenient storage hook, allowing you to hang up your headset when not in use.

feature_entries.title: Hear route guidance
feature_entries.description: Use this headset with a dēzl OTR navigation device (sold separately) so navigation prompts can seamlessly blend into the headset audio stream. Your voice commands can also be heard through your headset to control the navigator while your hands remain on the wheel. This requires use of the dēzl app on your compatible smartphone.

products.page_description: Experience unrivalled comfort with LinkBuds Fit earbuds. With excellent sound and call quality, and improved Ambient Sound Mode, staying connected to the people and content you love has never been easier.

feature_entries.title: Designed for comfort
feature_entries.description: Small, light, and smart, with a secure and comfortable fit–even when exercising–thanks to the newly developed earbud tips to keep you connected throughout your day.

feature_entries.title: Immersive audio and call clarity
feature_entries.description: It’s easier than ever to stay connected to the people and content you love. Enjoy your favorite music without distractions and exceptional call quality, even in noisy environments.

feature_entries.title: Colors to suit your style
feature_entries.description: LinkBuds Fit are available in a range of colors to fit your wardrobe, with the white and green editions including a unique marbled pattern on the case.

feature_entries.title: Stay connected with ambient sound
feature_entries.description: LinkBuds Fit combines excellent noise Cancelling with an improved Ambient Sound Mode. When activated, it automatically adjusts to your environment, reducing excess noise while keeping you safe and aware of your surroundings.

feature_entries.title: Adjusts to the world around you
feature_entries.description: Adaptive Sound Control senses where you are and what you’re doing, then uses AI to change ambient sound settings for the ideal listening experience. Over time, it can learn your behavior, recognize locations you visit often, and tailor the sound to suit your location.

feature_entries.title: Advanced Noise Cancelling
feature_entries.description: The LinkBuds Fit are equipped with our Integrated Processor V2, just like in our acclaimed WF-1000XM5, to optimize noise Cancelling in real time according to your environment. Plus, its dual noise sensor technology filters exterior sound using multiple microphones, for greater immersion. Auto Noise Cancelling Optimizer analyzes your surroundings to constantly adjust and optimize noise Cancelling wherever you are.

feature_entries.title: Enjoy richer, more detailed vocals
feature_entries.description: Our proprietary Dynamic Driver X is specifically designed to deliver a wide frequency response, for richer vocals and enhanced fine details. The diaphragm structure, which is also used with the WF-1000XM5, combines several different materials for the dome and the edge, achieving low distortion and a clear sound quality.

feature_entries.title: Battery life
feature_entries.description: With up to 5.5 hours playback in the buds, and 3 full top-ups in the case, you can leave the house with up to 21 hours of total playback. If you are running short on time, a 5-minute quick charge provides up to an hour of playback.

products.description: To the music lovers with a playlist for every mood and moment, meet your new obsession. Bose designed earbuds with OpenAudio technology that combines complete openness to your surroundings with rich, private sound only you can hear. Get your run on, take a call, go all day. Do whatever your thing is and pause for nothing. Compromise? A word you don’t believe in. With Bose Immersive Audio, the open-ear headphones don’t just feel good and look good, they bring you closer to your music. Bose Immersive Audio spatializes music so you’re not only listening to the music. You’re in it. Are you ready to change the way you listen?

The earbuds' open-ear design says, “I can still hear you” while OpenAudio technology provides you with high-quality, private sound.

feature_entries.title: Be in the music —anywhere, everywhere.
feature_entries.description: Get your run on, take a call, go all day. Do whatever your thing is and pause for nothing. Bose Immersive Audio spatializes music so you’re not only listening to the music. You’re in it.

feature_entries.title: A sight for sore ears.
feature_entries.description: Designed for comfortable all-day wear, you'll put these on and never want to take them off. The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds feature a flexible joint and stable, light-as-air-grip – you’ll forget you’re even wearing them.

feature_entries.title: Stay charged and never miss a beat.
feature_entries.description: With up to 7 hours of play time (up to 4 hours with Immersive Audio)¹ or up to 48 hours of standby,² you’re equipped with the power of long-lasting battery life. Plus, the included charging case provides up to an extra 19.5 hours of power, making it perfect for on-the-go charging³.

feature_entries.title: Press, play, enjoy.
feature_entries.description: Simple, satisfying button controls make it super easy to switch between stereo and immersive modes, giving you instant command over your listening experience. With just a press, effortlessly control your music and answer calls. Plus, Auto Volume works like magic to keep your music audible even as the volume of your surroundings change. Just turn it on in the Bose app and move from place to place without needing to adjust a thing.

feature_entries.title: Water resistance with IPX4.
feature_entries.description: Get splashed on, dripped on, sprayed on. No worries here. The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds can handle it. Acoustic mesh keeps out moisture and debris, so you can keep on listening.

feature_entries.title: Plays nicely with other Bose products.
feature_entries.description: Indulge in TV time without bothering anyone. Thanks to Bose SimpleSync technology, you can pair your open-ear wireless headphones with Bose smart soundbars and speakers for a personal TV listening experience with independent volume control.

feature_entries.title: Seamless connection with advanced Bluetooth 5.3.
feature_entries.description: Now with improved Bluetooth connectivity and easier, quicker setup. Advanced Bluetooth 5.3 offers a strong, continuous connection within 30 feet of your device.

feature_entries.title: Control everything through the Bose app.
feature_entries.description: Take personalization even further with Adjustable EQ settings in the Bose app. Control bass, mid-range, and treble levels as you go. Or use the app to check battery life, customize a shortcut, and manage connected devices.

products.page_description: Get ready for the JBL Tour One M3 Smart Tx, our best-sounding and most feature-rich over-ear headphones ever. Lose yourself in lossless audio from the built-in DAC. Or go wireless with stunning Hi-Res Audio via Bluetooth. JBL Spatial 360 sound with integrated head tracking makes movies and mobile games even more immersive. True Adaptive Noise Cancelling 2.0 tunes out distracting ambient noise in real-time, so you can concentrate on your work—or your favorite playlist. Use the JBL Smart Tx universal Bluetooth Audio Transmitter to elevate your wireless sound experience and connect to in-flight and other public spaces entertainment systems and seamlessly stream from Bluetooth devices. Customize and control your sound through the JBL Headphones app, accessible from the JBL Smart Tx display and share audio via the advanced Auracast connection with other Auracast-enabled devices.

feature_entries.title: Hi-Res Audio with legendary JBL Pro Sound
feature_entries.description: Robust 40mm mica dome drivers are precisely tuned to deliver deep bass, balanced mids, and crystal-clear highs. Thanks to the built-in Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC) you can enjoy lossless high sound quality with low distortion and accurate conversion from any device. Wireless fans can hear detailed Hi-Res Audio, closer than ever to how your music sounded in the studio, with LDAC.

feature_entries.title: Immersive JBL Spatial 360 sound with Head Tracking
feature_entries.description: Whether you're listening to music, movies, or games, next-generation JBL Spatial Sound is a more natural, realistic, and accurate immersive experience than ever before. It processes more details from any stereo content to generate reflections and reverberation signals. . And integrated head tracking means that sounds stay fixed in space even when you turn your head, adding a new layer of realism to your immersive listening.

feature_entries.title: 8-Mic True Adaptive Noise Cancelling 2.0 with real-time adjustments
feature_entries.description: Make wind, street noise, and workplace chatter all go away. 8 mics (4 on and in each ear cup) listen for ambient noises around you in real-time and automatically return the inverse phase to you, so you barely hear anything other than your music. Or, when you want to stay more aware of your surroundings, use Ambient Aware and Talk Thru in the JBL Headphones app to customize what and how much you hear of your environment.

feature_entries.title: 4 mics with adaptive beamforming technology for perfect calls
feature_entries.description: Four adaptive beamforming mics, powered by the AI algorithm, monitor your environment and intelligently eliminate both echoes and ambient noise from any direction. The JBL App allows to customize how you sound to others and how you want them to sound to you, or to bring down loud talkers or turn up quiet talkers. You can also control how much of your own voice you want to hear on calls, with VoiceAware.

feature_entries.title: JBL Smart Tx: Connect to any audio source
feature_entries.description: Use JBL Smart Tx to connect to just about any audio source and elevate your wireless sound experience. Or use the USB-C cable for digital sources like your phone, tablet, or laptop. Analog sources can also be connected by using the 3.5mm audio jack. That includes the in-flight entertainment system on most airplanes, your TV or PC. And with 18 hours of battery life*, you’ll make it through even the longest flight.

feature_entries.title: Smart audio and video
feature_entries.description: Get the best combination of audio and video possible. With the JBL Headphones app, you can optimize Bluetooth settings for more enjoyable experiences, whether you’re listening to music or streaming TV, movies, and videos.

feature_entries.title: Google Audio Switch
feature_entries.description: Seamlessly switch from one Android Bluetooth device to another. Jump from a video on your tablet to a call on your mobile phone, and never miss a moment.

feature_entries.title: Google Fast Pair
feature_entries.description: It just takes one click to pair your JBL Tour One M3 Smart Tx headphones to your Android Bluetooth device. After that, Google Fast Pair takes care of it for you.

feature_entries.title: Personi-Fi 3.0
feature_entries.description: Set up your own personalizes audio profile by simply taking the hearing test in the JBL Headphones app. Then use the 12-band EQ and separate L/R balance optimization to create your ideal sound using the entire frequency range. products.full_description: Get ready for the JBL Tour One M3 Smart Tx, our best-sounding and most feature-rich over-ear headphones ever. Lose yourself in lossless audio from the built-in DAC. Or go wireless with stunning Hi-Res Audio via Bluetooth. JBL Spatial 360 sound with integrated head tracking makes movies and mobile games even more immersive. True Adaptive Noise Cancelling 2.0 tunes out distracting ambient noise in real-time, so you can concentrate on your work—or your favorite playlist. Use the JBL Smart Tx universal Bluetooth Audio Transmitter to elevate your wireless sound experience and connect to in-flight and other public spaces entertainment systems and seamlessly stream from Bluetooth devices. Customize and control your sound through the JBL Headphones app, accessible from the JBL Smart Tx display and share audio via the advanced Auracast connection with other Auracast-enabled devices. Features: Hi-Res Audio with legendary JBL Pro Sound: Robust 40mm mica dome drivers are precisely tuned to deliver deep bass, balanced mids, and crystal-clear highs. Thanks to the built-in Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC) you can enjoy lossless high sound quality with low distortion and accurate conversion from any device. Wireless fans can hear detailed Hi-Res Audio, closer than ever to how your music sounded in the studio, with LDAC.; Immersive JBL Spatial 360 sound with Head Tracking: Whether you're listening to music, movies, or games, next-generation JBL Spatial Sound is a more natural, realistic, and accurate immersive experience than ever before. It processes more details from any stereo content to generate reflections and reverberation signals. . And integrated head tracking means that sounds stay fixed in space even when you turn your head, adding a new layer of realism to your immersive listening.; 8-Mic True Adaptive Noise Cancelling 2.0 with real-time adjustments: Make wind, street noise, and workplace chatter all go away. 8 mics (4 on and in each ear cup) listen for ambient noises around you in real-time and automatically return the inverse phase to you, so you barely hear anything other than your music. Or, when you want to stay more aware of your surroundings, use Ambient Aware and Talk Thru in the JBL Headphones app to customize what and how much you hear of your environment.; 4 mics with adaptive beamforming technology for perfect calls: Four adaptive beamforming mics, powered by the AI algorithm, monitor your environment and intelligently eliminate both echoes and ambient noise from any direction. The JBL App allows to customize how you sound to others and how you want them to sound to you, or to bring down loud talkers or turn up quiet talkers. You can also control how much of your own voice you want to hear on calls, with VoiceAware.; JBL Smart Tx: Connect to any audio source: Use JBL Smart Tx to connect to just about any audio source and elevate your wireless sound experience. Or use the USB-C cable for digital sources like your phone, tablet, or laptop. Analog sources can also be connected by using the 3.5mm audio jack. That includes the in-flight entertainment system on most airplanes, your TV or PC. And with 18 hours of battery life*, you’ll make it through even the longest flight.; Smart audio and video: Get the best combination of audio and video possible. With the JBL Headphones app, you can optimize Bluetooth settings for more enjoyable experiences, whether you’re listening to music or streaming TV, movies, and videos.; Google Audio Switch: Seamlessly switch from one Android Bluetooth device to another. Jump from a video on your tablet to a call on your mobile phone, and never miss a moment.; Google Fast Pair: It just takes one click to pair your JBL Tour One M3 Smart Tx headphones to your Android Bluetooth device. After that, Google Fast Pair takes care of it for you.; Personi-Fi 3.0: Set up your own personalizes audio profile by simply taking the hearing test in the JBL Headphones app. Then use the 12-band EQ and separate L/R balance optimization to create your ideal sound using the entire frequency range. The new UI and algorithm make Personi-Fi 3.0 more accurate than ever before.; Bluetooth 5.3 with LE audio: Bluetooth 5.3 LE lets you sync independent audio streams to the JBL Tour One M3 Smart Tx while keeping power consumption low. Pair up to two Bluetooth devices at the same time and then switch effortlessly from one to another, so you won’t miss a call. And with Auracast, the JBL Tour One M3 can receive content from any other Auracast-enabled sources, such as gym entertainment, airport announcements, TV or gaming consoles, through the JBL App. Specifications: Noise Cancelling (Active): Yes; Sound Mode: Simulated Surround, Stereo; Connection Type: Wireless, Wired; Wireless Connectivity: Bluetooth; True Wireless: No; Maximum Wireless Range: 33 feet; Water Resistant: No; Built-In Microphone: Yes; Carrying Case: Yes; Microphone Features: Noise cancelling; Headphone Fit: Over-the-Ear; Adjustable Headband: Yes; Battery Life: 70 hours; Works With: Amazon Alexa, Apple Home, SmartThings, Google Home; Voice Assistant Built-in: Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant; Brand: JBL; Model Number: JBLTOM3AVIBLKAM; Product Name: Tour One M3 Aviator - 2025; Color: Black; Noise Cancelling (Active): Yes; Sound Isolating: Yes; Environmental Noise Control: Yes; Minimum Frequency Response: 10 hertz; Maximum Frequency Response: 40 kilohertz
